d97215677ceb10498d15.title: Patient Appointment Services (PAS) Clerk
d97215677ceb10498d15.description:
**Company Description**

Help patients access the care they need by making appointment scheduling and coordination easier. In this military healthcare environment, you'll be a key point of contact for patients arranging primary care, specialty referrals, and follow-up appointments.

At International SOS Government Medical Services, you'll support healthcare programs that improve patient care and operational readiness across the U.S. and internationally. Founded in 1984, International SOS operates in more than 90 countries, delivering healthcare, medical assistance, emergency response, and workforce support services worldwide.

 **Job Description**

In this role, you'll support patient appointment services within a centralized healthcare call center serving military beneficiaries. You'll handle incoming and outgoing calls, coordinate primary and specialty care appointments, and help patients navigate scheduling requests and next steps.

Your work will involve electronic healthcare systems, including MHS GENESIS, to maintain accurate appointment information, process requests, and support timely access to care.

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Residence Requirement:** Candidate must reside within 50 miles of San Antonio, TX.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* $17.10–$18.00 per hour
* Health and Welfare (H&W) benefit of up to $5.09 per hour, in accordance with the Service Contract Act (SCA).

**Schedule:** Full-time, with varying shifts Monday–Friday between 6:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. Pacific Time, including rotating Saturday or Sunday shifts every other weekend between 7:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Candidates must be available to work any assigned shift within these hours. Overtime may be required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate appointments: Schedule, reschedule, and cancel primary and specialty care appointments, including correcting booking errors.
* Assist patients: Handle inbound and outbound calls, answer scheduling questions, and work toward resolving inquiries during the initial call.
* Verify information: Confirm patient eligibility, update demographic information, and maintain accurate appointment records.
* Support specialty care: Coordinate referral appointments, preventive care scheduling, and patient reminders, including pre-appointment instructions.
* Manage electronic requests: Process secure messages, document interactions in MHS GENESIS, and prepare patient notification letters.
* Collaborate across teams: Work with healthcare departments and administrative teams to support scheduling accuracy, service standards, and patient access.

  
**Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* High school diploma or GED equivalent.
* Basic computer skills and the ability to learn and use Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Excel, and Outlook, along with other required computer systems and technologies.
* Ability to provide courteous, professional customer service to internal and external customers and communicate effectively by telephone, verbally, and in writing, including handling or routing calls and inquiries.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, organize priorities, and complete assigned tasks accurately within required timeframes while maintaining records and documentation.
* Ability to follow established procedures and instructions and seek assistance or clarification when needed.

  
**Additional Information**

**Privacy Disclaimer:** **Policy Link**

By clicking “I’m Interested” and submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the applicable Privacy Policy (available via the link above) and agree that International SOS Government Medical Services, may collect, use, store, transfer, and otherwise process your personal information in accordance with that Privacy Policy for recruitment and hiring purposes.

**Compensation Disclaimer:**  
Pay range is based on several factors and may vary in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant’s background, experience, skills, internal equity, and alignment with geographical market data.

**Benefits Language (FTE roles):**  
Full-time positions are eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k plan, paid time off, and an annual bonus. International SOS Government Medical Services complies with all federal, state, and local minimum wage laws.

**Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) Statement:**  
International SOS Government Medical Services is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

429d636c9c10f352cc29.description:
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Schedule up to 300 MRI department patient appointments per week
* Understand scheduling rules for MRI scheduling- 1.5T vs 3
* Screen patients for metal, pacemakers, etc.. during scheduling
* Perform a variety of scheduling duties via telephone, fax, and health information exchange
* Answer incoming phone calls
* Coordinate and confirm MRI appointment times
* Answer patient questions and directing calls and messages to the appropriate personnel
* Obtain proper documentation for appointments
* Maintain patient confidence and protect operations by keeping information confidential
* Report to the office location, as needed
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as deemed appropriate

  

**GENERAL COMPENTENCIES DESIRED**

  

* Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently, with minimal supervision.
* Excellent organizational, communication skills, telephone, and exceptional customer service skills.
* Ability to interact effectively with patients and co-workers and possess excellent listening and interpretive skills.
* Ability to be comfortable in learning and using digital tools.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, remaining calm and helpful under pressure and emergency situations.
* PC skills required with a typing speed of approximately 35 wpm.
* Good problem solving skills required in order to maximize effectiveness and efficiency of job duties

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

Requires frequent standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time. Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity necessary for operation of basic office equipment such as computer terminal and telephone. Requires use of the telephone. Requires hearing and eye sight in normal acuity range. Requires ability to work quickly under high stress with patients who are irritable or confused.

Must have a high school diploma or equivalent education and at least one year experience in a medical setting or customer service field.

**HOURS: MONDAY-FRIDAY**

**Description**

Your passion belongs at UNC Health. Join more than 56,000 teammates working together to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve across North Carolina.

**Summary:**  
This role is responsible in ensuring that patient access processing is performed in accordance with procedure and documented in a timely and accurate manner in ADT and other clinical information systems. Meets departmental/organizational outcome targets  
for process accuracy and timeliness.

**Responsibilities:**  
Ensures and verifies key ADT information (insurance verification, patient and guarantor demographics, etc.) is current and accurate to ensure patient safety, charging, coding, insurance processing, and billing accuracy.  
Schedules all new and follow-up patient appointments as required. Attempt to reschedule cancellations whenever possible. Communicates cancellations to provider as necessary.  
Completes and documents all governmental, regulatory, financial, and contractual forms in accordance to procedure. Ensures document is scanned/saved to correct location and is legible.  
Utilizes price estimation tool, when applicable, as part of the registration process to provide the most accurate estimate to patients  
Meets departmental target for up front collections to include deposits, estimated amounts due, co-pays, and/or prior balances.  
Actively participates in departmental QA by utilizing system work queues, making a personal effort to reduce individual errors, and making corrections. Utilizes system work queues as a daily part of the registration process to minimize errors.

**Professional Experience Requirements:**

40

**Cost Center:**

99940 - 5492 Patient Access Center

**Union:**

SHARE (State Healthcare and Research Employees)

This position may have a signing bonus available a member of the Recruitment Team will confirm eligibility during the interview process.

**Everyone Is a Caregiver**
===========================

At UMass Memorial Health, everyone is a caregiver – regardless of their title or responsibilities. Exceptional patient care, academic excellence and leading-edge research make UMass Memorial the premier health system of Central Massachusetts, and a place where we can help you build the career you deserve. We are more than 20,000 employees, working together as one health system in a relentless pursuit of healing for our patients, community and each other. And everyone, in their own unique way, plays an important part, every day.

The role of the Patient Access Scheduling Agent is the front door for patients to secure access to the right care, at the right time, with the right provider. The Patient Access Scheduling agent performs a variety of complex scheduling activities that ensures patients get access to the care they need by providing exceptional patient service.

I. Major Responsibilities:
  
1. Handles incoming phone calls from patients, families and referring providers to schedule patient appointments. Scheduling scope includes multiple providers across multiple clinics/departments, practices across multiple campuses.
  
2. Makes outbound phone calls to patients to schedule appointments with specialists and subspecialists.
  
3. As part of the appointment scheduling process, secure the information needed to facilitate the financial aspects of medical care such as patient demographics (name, date of birth, etc.), insurance information, and account guarantor. Processes updates and corrections to patient insurance and demographic information. Collects patient liabilities prior to or on the date of service, as appropriate.
  
4. Based upon appointment visit type, secure medical records from outside health care organizations to ensure the provider has the necessary medical information to provide care.
  
5. Schedules in office procedures (such as biopsies, etc.), which often requires scheduling the appointment and scheduling the room where the procedure will take place.

II. Position Qualifications:

License/Certification/Education:
  
Required:
  
1. High school diploma.

Preferred:
  
1. Associate’s degree in business or healthcare-related field.

Experience/Skills:
  
Required:
  
1. English speaking, reading and writing skills.
  
2. Strong intrapersonal and communication skills.

Preferred:
  
1. Previous scheduling and/or phone customer services experience.
  
2. Previous experience in a health care organization.
  
3. Bilingual speaking, reading, and writing skills.

Unless certification, licensure or registration is required, an equivalent combination of education and experience which provides proficiency in the areas of responsibility listed in this description may be substituted for the above requirements.

Department-specific competencies and their measurements will be developed and maintained in the individual departments. The competencies will be maintained and attached to the departmental job description. Responsible managers will review competencies with position incumbents.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

We’re striving to make respect a part of everything we do at UMass Memorial Health – for our patients, our community and each other. Our six Standards of Respect are: Acknowledge, Listen, Communicate, Be Responsive, Be a Team Player and Be Kind. If you share these Standards of Respect, we hope you will join our team and help us make respect our standard for everyone, every day.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, UMass Memorial Health recognizes the power of a diverse community and encourages applications from individuals with varied experiences, perspectives and backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

64c1e99a7402a876af5b.title: Food Service Operations Coordinator
64c1e99a7402a876af5b.description:
Job Summary

Bad Brother is seeking a **Food Service Operations Coordinator** to support daily restaurant operations, coordinate food service activities, and maintain efficient workflows across kitchen and front-of-house teams. This role assists with staff coordination, inventory monitoring, service quality, operational records, and customer service to help ensure smooth restaurant operations and a positive guest experience.

Common Job Roles

* Food Service Operations Coordinator
* Restaurant Operations Coordinator
* Food Service Coordinator
* Restaurant Operations Specialist
* Hospitality Operations Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily food service activities and restaurant workflows.
* Communicate operational updates between kitchen staff, service teams, and management.
* Assist with staff scheduling, shift coordination, and task assignments.
* Monitor service operations to help maintain quality and efficiency standards.
* Support inventory tracking, supply ordering, and receiving activities.
* Coordinate food preparation and order fulfillment with kitchen team members.
* Help maintain consistent food quality, presentation, and service standards.
* Respond to routine customer concerns and coordinate follow-up when needed.
* Maintain accurate operational records, reports, and administrative documentation.
* Assist with employee onboarding, training coordination, and team communication.
* Monitor food service supplies and report shortages or operational issues.
* Help coordinate opening, closing, and routine restaurant procedures.
* Follow food safety, sanitation, hygiene, and workplace safety requirements.
* Perform additional food service and operational duties assigned by management.

Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred; hospitality or business education is an asset.
* Previous restaurant, food service, hospitality, or operations experience is preferred.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Basic computer, spreadsheet, and recordkeeping proficiency.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional attitude and strong teamwork skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees, managers, and customers.
* Flexible availability for assigned shifts, including evenings and weekends when required.

Preferred Skills

* Experience coordinating restaurant or food service operations.
* Familiarity with POS, inventory, scheduling, or restaurant management systems.
* Knowledge of food service workflows and customer service standards.
* Strong time management and multitasking abilities.
* Understanding of food safety and sanitation procedures.
* Good conflict-resolution and communication skills.
* Ability to identify workflow issues and support operational improvements.

About the Company

Bad Brother operates in the restaurant and hospitality industry, where organized food service, reliable teamwork, and attentive customer care are essential to daily operations. The restaurant team focuses on food quality, efficient service, cleanliness, and a welcoming dining experience.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 37.0 per week

Work Location: In person

8b8668a768d226ed7185.title: Training Coordinator
8b8668a768d226ed7185.description:
It’s great to work at a place where people are truly committed to serving our students! We’re committed to bringing passion and energy to our College.

Visit our Life Page on LinkedIn to explore our dynamic campus culture, hear from current employees, and discover what makes Bucks County Community College a great place to work!

This position is responsible for coordinating on-site and off-site public safety training programs; selecting and scheduling adjunct instructors; evaluating instructor performance; and managing required course equipment, resources, and materials. The position also oversees support staff responsible for coordinating, processing, and documenting all information related to on-site and off-site operations.

This position reports directly to the Director of Operations. Additional assignments may be assigned by the Executive Director of Public Safety. The incumbent will actively participate in strategic planning and administrative support initiatives.

This position requires a responsible, self-motivated individual who can serve as a leader in a high-volume, fast-paced office environment. The successful candidate must be flexible in work scheduling, capable of multitasking, able to work effectively amid frequent interruptions, and committed to meeting established deadlines for assigned tasks.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinating on-site and off-site public safety training courses for emergency services organizations.
* Select qualified and certified adjunct instructors for training courses.
* Manage office operations at the training facility.
* Manage the support staff at the training facility.
Perform special projects as assigned.  

  

**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITY**

Proctor and evaluate certification examinations as requested.  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or general equivalency diploma (GED) and three years of work experience, or an associate degree.
* 4 - 6 years of job-related experience in customer service.
* Knowledge of FERPA regulations, policies, and procedures, and of the State Training System as defined by the Office of the State Fire Commissioner. Experience with the PA Public Safety Training System and professional certification testing.
* Management and customer service skills.
* Good interpersonal skills.
* Basic skills in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Basic project management skills.
* Valid driver's license.
* All office staff must have Child Abuse Clearance due to their interaction with minors in relation to courses.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability for off-site training and testing opportunities.
* Strong organizational and detail-oriented skills.
* Experience with the Colleague database.
* Good problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in an active environment with constant interruptions.
* Effective communication skills with a diverse student and instructor population.
* Capacity to manage a heavy workload.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude when dealing with agitated students and/or instructors.
* Proficiency in multitasking.
* Ability to move and set up various training props and tools.

**Salary Range** $50,618 - 64,630 (commensurate with experience)

  

**Benefits**

Bucks County Community College offers an exceptional benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, prescription plans, 403B pension plan, life insurance, short & long-term disability, generous paid time off, tuition waivers, tuition assistance, wellness center, cafeteria, and free parking on a beautiful Bucks County campus.

**Background Checks/Clearances**

Employment with the College will require successful completion of background check(s) in accordance with the College's policies, including a Pennsylvania Background Check, FBI Fingerprint Clearance, and Pennsylvania Child Abuse History Clearance.

**Application**

Apply online at: https://bucks.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/BCCC

Applications must consist of a letter of application addressing this specific position and the candidate’s interest and qualifications for coming to Bucks County Community College, resume/CV, and professional references. References will not be contacted without prior permission. Finalists may be asked to provide additional materials.

**Deadline**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

We are proud to be an organization that embraces the value of bringing diverse, talented, and committed people together. The fastest way to breakthrough innovation is when diverse ideas come together in an inclusive environment. We encourage our colleagues to respectfully challenge one another’s thinking and approach problems collectively. We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Please Note: At this time, the College does not provide work visa sponsorships. To be considered for employment at Bucks County Community College, applicants must be permitted to legally work in the United States without employer sponsorship. *Bucks County Community College participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.*

8475b8d4e8e1f5e477bb.title: Logistics Coordinator
8475b8d4e8e1f5e477bb.description:
**Logistics Coordinator (Remote)**

**Location:** Remote, United States (Eastern and Central Time zones)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** Procurement Manager  
**Salary Range:** $65,000 – $75,000 annually

*Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity.*

**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized **Logistics Coordinator** to support procurement, transportation, and supply chain operations across our business. This role is responsible for coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate records, communicating with suppliers and carriers, and ensuring products move efficiently from origin to destination.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving problems, and excels at keeping multiple priorities organized while delivering exceptional customer service.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate domestic inbound and outbound shipments from order release through final delivery.
* Schedule shipments and deliveries with suppliers, carriers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor shipment status, proactively identify delays or issues, and communicate updates and resolution plans.
* Prepare and maintain shipping documentation, purchase order records, tracking information, and logistics files.
* Verify freight charges, assist with invoice reconciliation, and escalate discrepancies as needed.
* Maintain accurate data within ERP, inventory, transportation, and carrier management systems.
* Support inventory visibility, procurement activities, and supplier relationships.
* Track logistics performance metrics and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Respond promptly to internal and external customer inquiries.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and operational standards.

**Qualifications Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in logistics, transportation, shipping, procurement, order management, or a related coordination role.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience with ERP, TMS, WMS, or carrier management systems.
* Knowledge of shipping documentation, inventory management, and transportation processes.

**Remote Work Expectations**

* Maintain a reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated workspace.
* Be available during standard business hours and responsive through company communication tools.
* Participate in virtual meetings and collaborate effectively across multiple time zones.
* Occasional travel to company, supplier, warehouse, or customer locations may be required.

**Why Join Us?**

You'll play an important role in keeping our supply chain running smoothly while working with a collaborative team focused on operational excellence, customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Our Core Values**

We believe in:

* Integrity
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork
* Respect for People
* Accountability
* Open Communication
* Continuous Improvement

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process and during employment.

97cc38a96ed1f088a419.title: IT Operations & Onboarding Coordinator
97cc38a96ed1f088a419.description:
**About Blueprint**

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

**Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.**

**About the Role**
------------------

In this role, As a Vendor Onboarding & SAW Administrator, you will oversee the end-to-end onboarding and administrative support of external vendors, ensuring they have the equipment, system access, and compliance approvals required to perform their work. You will manage the lifecycle of Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs) and related security devices, coordinate account provisioning and equipment logistics, and track onboarding requirements from initial intake through completion. Working closely with vendors, managers, engineering teams, procurement, and support organizations across multiple time zones, you will maintain accurate records, resolve administrative and basic technical issues, manage outstanding requests, and proactively address compliance gaps. Your work will help streamline onboarding operations, maintain security and compliance standards, and allow technical teams to focus on their core responsibilities.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

Manage end-to-end vendor onboarding, from initial intake and documentation through account provisioning, equipment delivery, and handoff to the appropriate technical team.

* Administer Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs), including request coordination, setup, shipment tracking, returns, replacements, and ongoing lifecycle management.

* Coordinate the ordering, provisioning, shipping, and return of smartcards, card readers, security keys, and other required access devices.

* Submit, monitor, and follow up on external workforce records, background screenings, required training, purchase orders, organizational identifiers, and system access requests.

* Monitor and maintain vendor compliance records, including GOVID and SSPA status, and follow up on outstanding requirements and overdue attestations.

* Provide basic technical support for SAW onboarding, computer setup, and access-related issues, escalating complex problems to the appropriate support teams.

* Manage onboarding and SAW work queues by maintaining accurate status updates, reviewing aging requests, addressing backlogs, tracking dependencies, and escalating delays.

* Coordinate account reinstatements, onboarding holds, expired screenings, and re-onboarding activities in partnership with relevant HR and support teams.

* Maintain and update onboarding procedures and documentation to reflect process changes, operational requirements, and compliance standards.

* Coordinate with vendors, managers, engineering teams, procurement, mailrooms, and support organizations across U.S., EMEA, and APAC time zones.

* Maintain accurate and confidential records related to vendor onboarding, screening, equipment, account access, and compliance activities.

* Proactively communicate outstanding actions, deadlines, and compliance gaps to vendors and internal stakeholders to support timely res

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Human Resources, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.

* 3+ years of experience in IT administration, vendor onboarding, administrative operations, workforce coordination, procurement support, IT asset logistics, or a related function.

* 3+ years of experience with computer or workstation administration, preferably involving Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs) or similar enterprise-managed devices.

* Experience managing high-volume, multi-step workflows using ticketing systems, work-management platforms, or other tracking tools.

* Demonstrated project coordination and workflow management skills, including prioritization, status tracking, follow-up, escalation, and backlog management.

* Strong organizational, documentation, time-management, and stakeholder communication skills.

* Ability to manage sensitive personnel information, background screening records, account details, and access-related documentation with discretion.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple requests, competing priorities, and time-sensitive onboarding activities.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate effectively with stakeholders across multiple time zones.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold stakeholders accountable for outstanding actions and compliance requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs), enterprise-managed computers, or other security-controlled endpoint environments.

* Familiarity with enterprise account provisioning, identity and access management, and secure device setup.

* Experience coordinating secure-device logistics, including smartcards, card readers, hardware security keys, equipment returns, and replacements.

55537ed9b34aa92d01b5.title: Implementation Coordinator
55537ed9b34aa92d01b5.description:
At LinderConnect, we help businesses handle customer calls more efficiently through AI-powered communication tools. But before those tools can make a difference, someone needs to make sure everything is set up properly.

We're hiring an Implementation Coordinator to help new customers get started with our services.

You'll spend your time talking with customers, gathering the details we need, coordinating with our team, and making sure each setup moves forward without unnecessary complications.

We don't expect you to know everything about AI or telecommunications. We're looking for someone who's organized, comfortable learning new technology, and good at working with people.

What You'll Be Working On

* Help new customers through the setup and implementation process.
* Gather information about each customer's business, operating hours, and call-handling needs.
* Coordinate the setup of AI phone agents, call routing, and automated follow-up features.
* Schedule customer meetings and keep implementation timelines organized.
* Communicate with internal teams to make sure setup requirements are understood.
* Track outstanding tasks and follow up on missing information.
* Assist with testing phone workflows before customers begin using the service.
* Keep customers updated on progress and answer questions throughout the process.
* Maintain accurate customer records, setup notes, and project documentation.
* Help customers become familiar with their new communication tools.
* Coordinate the handoff to customer support after implementation is complete.

What We're Hoping You Bring

At least **1–3 years of experience** in customer onboarding, project coordination, technical support, business operations, software services, or a similar role.

You should enjoy keeping things organized, communicating with different people, and finding solutions when something doesn't go as planned.

Experience with CRM systems, SaaS products, scheduling tools, or telecommunications is helpful, but not required.

Strong computer skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple customer accounts are important.

An associate or bachelor's degree in business, technology, or a related field is preferred, but relevant work experience is equally valued.

4cd7fce20e9c497f2632.title: Business Operations Specialist
4cd7fce20e9c497f2632.description:
**About Second Front Systems**

Second Front is a venture-backed company on a mission to strengthen global security by accelerating access to emerging technologies for the U.S. and our allies. Founded by Marines who saw firsthand how outdated government acquisition systems held back frontline personnel, we help commercial software companies get mission-critical technology into the hands of government users faster — backed by FedRAMP High, DoD IL2–IL6/JWICS, GovRAMP, UK MOD, and NATO authorizations. Our team is mission-obsessed, collaborative, and decisive, and we’re proud to be Great Place to Work certified.

**About the Role**

Second Front Systems is looking for an organized, detail-oriented, and process-driven Business Operations Specialist to strengthen our regional operations and administrative infrastructure in the Netherlands.

This role sits at the intersection of business operations and people operations. You’ll coordinate employment, IT, and administrative workflows with the Head of EMEA and relevant global teams — translating deployment readiness and resource needs into workforce planning and operational staffing. You’ll own regional coordination, documentation, and issue follow-through across People Operations, Finance, Legal, IT, and Security, making sure deadlines, approvals, and open action items get tracked to completion.

Day to day, that means managing Dutch employment administration (contracts, right-to-work documentation, payroll inputs, leave, pension, and benefits), coordinating with payroll, HR, accounting, legal, and corporate-service providers, and maintaining regional operating records, SOPs, entity documentation, and cost-center information. You’ll act as the primary EMEA back-office point of contact across our Dutch and UK entities — the operational bridge between our regional teams, U.S. shared services, and external European providers.

**Work authorization & location:** Candidates must hold the right to work in the Netherlands and be based in the Netherlands (Remote).

**Employment type & schedule:** This position may start part-time with the opportunity to grow into full-time, and may be structured as either an employee contract or an independent services/contractor agreement — the specific arrangement, weekly hours, and schedule will be confirmed during the offer process and set out in the engagement contract. Compensation for a part-time or hourly arrangement will be pro-rated accordingly.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate employment, IT, legal, and administrative workflows across EMEA operations, U.S. shared services, and European providers on a regular monthly cadence.
* Administer Dutch employment processes: contracts, right-to-work verification, payroll inputs, leave, pension, and benefits, in line with local statutory requirements.
* Track external provider deliverables, requests, approvals, and deadlines through to completion; maintain SOPs so the work is repeatable and audit-ready.
* Coordinate personnel-security clearance administration between EMEA, U.S. Security, NATO, and customer programs, and flag anything blocking accreditation.
* Compile the entity and cost-center data needed for consolidated EMEA reporting, and support vendor onboarding and purchasing approval workflows.
* Document and maintain processes that turn recurring administrative tasks into repeatable regional operations with clear ownership.
* Translate business unit hiring needs into timelines and skill profiles aligned with mission schedules and customer accreditation gates.
* Help resolve misalignment between finance, program management, and HR systems, and keep budget execution in sync with onboarding and deployment timelines.
* Partner with operations leadership and People Ops on headcount allocation, role structure, and retention decisions during contract transitions.

**What You Bring**

* 3–5+ years of experience in business operations, People Operations, HR operations, or cross-functional subsidiary administration.
* Based in the Netherlands, with demonstrated experience supporting Dutch employment administration, payroll coordination, and local HR/benefits provider relationships.
* A track record of coordinating external payroll processors, HR platforms, accounting firms, legal counsel, and corporate service providers.
* Experience managing employment across multiple countries, legal entities, and contractor models, including employer-of-record arrangements.
* Demonstrated discipline in maintaining organized systems for confidential employment records, legal documents, and company data.
* Fluent written and spoken English for stakeholder coordination and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company through European subsidiaries or Dutch BV entity operations.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The full-time-equivalent (FTE) base salary range for this position is €65,000–€78,000 per year. If this role is engaged on a part-time or hourly basis, pay will be pro-rated from this FTE range and confirmed as part of the offer/contract. Actual compensation will depend on professional background, technical proficiency, seniority, and regional cost factors, and this role may also be eligible for equity awards and discretionary bonuses as part of a broader total rewards package.

**Equal Opportunity**

Second Front Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, ran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: €65K - €78K

e610d76f1b52c7d4bd37.title: Growth Specialist I, Preferred
e610d76f1b52c7d4bd37.description:
**About the team**
------------------

The Zillow Preferred team partners with top real estate professionals to help them deliver outstanding experiences for home shoppers. We're building the next generation of partner success: AI-powered where it should be, human-led where it matters most, and always grounded in customer outcomes. To do that at scale, we are building a frontline that combines operational rigor, sound judgment, and a shared commitment to exceptional partner experiences.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Growth Specialist I, Preferred, you are part of a frontline team that delivers timely, consistent support to Zillow Preferred partners and their agents. You'll work strategic outreach queues driven by data-based signals, respond to inbound support tickets **and** partner inquiries, and help partners navigate key moments in their journey, from onboarding and early ramp, to day-to-day operations, to performance management.

  

This role operates within a structured, team-based model. You work from a shared book of business rather than owning a named book of business, so coverage stays consistent and no partner depends on one person being available. Depending on business needs, you may focus on a particular area of partner and agent support (such as new partner onboarding, operational topics, or performance basics), but the core expectation across all focus areas is the same: be responsive, follow process, and deliver reliable first-touch support.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Support Partner Onboarding and Platform Adoption**
----------------------------------------------------

* Help new partners and agents navigate early lifecycle steps, including ramp-up on Zillow platforms and offerings such as Follow Up Boss and Zillow Home Loans.
* Guide partners through key post-activation workflows, including onboarding navigation, feature usage and adoption, and basic operational setup, ensuring they understand next steps and available self-service resources.
Reinforce relevant best practices, program tips, and recommended actions with partners as outlined in team playbooks, connecting them to the right tools, content, or team if needs fall outside your scope.  

  

**Engage, Respond, and Resolve**
--------------------------------

* Work through trigger-based, proactive outreach queues by reviewing performance signals, prioritizing based on defined criteria, and taking first-touch action within established workflows.
Handle inbound partner and agent inquiries across assigned channels (phone, email, or case management tools), provide guidance within defined playbooks and route technical or account issues to the appropriate support team.  

  

**Track & Document Activity and Flag Concerns**
-----------------------------------------------

* Use available reporting tools to monitor partner activity and key performance indicators within your assigned workflow.
* Identify patterns, flag concerns, and surface observations based on predefined playbooks; escalate systemic, complex, or sensitive issues through the proper channels.
Maintain detailed, up-to-date records of partner interactions and cases in designated systems to support service continuity, quality review, and compliance.  

  

**Learn and Contribute**
------------------------

* Identify recurring questions, content gaps, or workflow friction and share structured feedback with teammates and leaders to improve documentation, playbooks, and tools.
* Collaborate with peers and cross-functional partners to resolve issues and meet defined service levels and quality standards.
Participate in team learning sessions to build product, process, and program knowledge.  

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* Consistently achieve 90% or more of weekly KPIs, including response and resolution time against defined SLAs, outreach queue completion, and case documentation quality.
* Meet quality and accuracy standards on partner interactions as measured through regular QA review.
* Complete assigned trigger-based outreach within the defined window so every partner in the covered book is touched on the expected cadence.

This role has been categorized as a Field position. “Field” employees perform the majority of their work in a specified geographic location set by their management team. Employees are expected to live within a reasonable commuting distance to their region and/or service area. ZG has not defined a reasonable distance and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications regarding time commitment and cost of daily commute.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $41.40 - $66.20 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $39.30 - $62.90 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of experience in customer success, customer support, account coordination, or a similar customer-facing role.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting customers or external partners.
* Experience using CRM or case management tools (Salesforce preferred) with an aptitude to learn new platforms quickly.
Comfortable documenting interactions and managing cases or tickets in a structured workflow environment.  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in real estate, proptech, SaaS, or a performance-based partner program.
* Comfort working with data signals or AI-assisted tools to prioritize work and guide action.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Follow Up Boss, Tableau, or similar tools with a willingness to improve proficiency.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-up skills and the ability to manage multiple active cases simultaneously.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

5d1d961d1c1fedc9d5af.title: Radiology Workflow Coordinator I
5d1d961d1c1fedc9d5af.description:
* **This position will require a two-week onsite training before transitioning into fully remote.**

**Monday - Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm**

The Radiology Workflow Coordinator (RWC) supports RAF radiologists, referring physicians, site technologists, and other clinical and administrative stakeholders by serving as a central point of communication for specific modalities as needed, such as mammography, PET, and cardiac imaging. Reporting to the Vice President of Technology, the RWC facilitates two-way communication, minimizes workflow interruptions, and ensures timely completion of requests for assigned modalities. Using expertise in medical imaging informatics, radiology workflows, and related applications, the RWC monitors worklists, fulfills or routes requests, provides notifications, and supports all aspects of radiology and imaging informatics workflows for radiologists, staff, partner facilities, and referring providers.-

Major Duties & Responsibilities

Radiology Workflow Support as applicable for modalities as assigned

* Facilitate two-way communication between RAF radiologists and partner facility contacts:

o Receive requests from radiologists and route to the appropriate facility, department, or resource.

o Receive requests from partner facility contacts and handle directly or route to the appropriate resource.

* Assist radiologists and IT in maintaining diagnostic workstations and third-party applications, including basic PC support, server familiarity, and network troubleshooting.
* Support radiologists, technologists, and stakeholders in optimizing PACS and IT workflows.
* Monitor worklists to ensure timely study readings and results delivery:

o Notify sites of QC issues (missing paperwork, additional imaging, priors requests).

o Communicate critical results and findings promptly.

o Provide bidirectional feedback to resolve issues efficiently.

* Manage procedure code mapping, including researching and mapping new or incorrect codes.
* Support QC initiatives and continuous quality improvement.
* Troubleshoot HL7 message workflows and collaborate with development teams when issues cannot be resolved directly.

Radiology Application and Interface Support

* Serve as a resource for applications across multiple platforms and interfaces.
* Support PACS/RIS interfaces with other clinical systems and affiliate institutions.
* Manage radiologist dictation templates for mammography or assigned modality.

o Create, update, and troubleshoot templates.

o Maintain and update procedure code mappings.

o Perform routine and point-in-time backups.

o Import templates for radiologists as needed.

* Respond promptly to system performance or availability issues, providing clear communication to staff and partner sites during incidents and confirming resolution.
* Track and manage internal and third-party service tickets from initiation to resolution.

General Support

* Assist with new account setups, onboarding, and training for physicians and staff.
* Maintain positive relationships with affiliated healthcare organizations and IT partners to ensure timely query resolution.
* Support administrators in maintaining, auditing, and ensuring compliance of application access rights.
* Remote role with no routine off-hours work; occasional after-hours work may be required for staffing emergencies.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor, to include supporting the PACS general worklist and RWC call line during peak times or gaps in schedule.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in a healthcare related field, medical informatics, or information technology is preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree.
* Customer service / customer support experience required.
* Experience with radiology processes, procedures, and workflows in a hospital/clinical setting.
* Knowledge and experience with EMR, RIS, voice recognition system, DICOM modality worklists, integrated workflows, networks, typical HL7 integration and messaging, XML, HTML, medical modalities, image transmission, and remote support highly desired.
* Radiologic Technologist certification / licensure is preferred, or alternatively, experience in IT support with relevant IT certifications.

f6ac98c8d58a1a1eb13e.title: Medical Billing, AR and Contracts Specialist
f6ac98c8d58a1a1eb13e.description:
**Location**: Remote (Candidate must be US-based)

**Salary**: $20.00 - $24.00 per hour DOE

**Job Type**: Full-time

**Schedule**: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time

**Industry**: Behavior and Mental Health Services

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a Billing, AR, and Contracts Assistant to support billing, revenue cycle, and contracting operations across our clinical and administrative teams. This role is responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of billing processes, payer interactions, collections, reporting, and compliance activities.

This position supports the end-to-end Accounts Receivable workflow, including claim submission, payment posting, denial management, audit preparation, payer enrollment, rate and code maintenance, and financial reporting. The assistant will also contact funders to establish Single Case Agreements and explore potential new contracts. This requires someone skilled at building and maintaining professional relationships with funders, following up consistently, and ensuring all agreements and processes meet payer and regulatory compliance requirements.

The Billing, AR, and Contracts Assistant will serve as a key cross-functional partner to Clinical, Contract Fulfillment (CF), Accounting, and Leadership. They will help ensure services are billed correctly, reimbursements are optimized, payer requirements are met, and teams have reliable, transparent data to support operational and financial decisions.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong organizational and systems-thinking skills, close attention to detail, relationship-building abilities, and proactive problem-solving.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Billing & Revenue Cycle**

* Own and manage all daily, weekly, and monthly billing and AR operations.
* Oversee full-cycle billing for all payers, including:

  + PHC, SUSD, NVUSD, EL, NBRC, Carelon, Acumen, private pay, co-pay, and co-insurance.
* Ensure timely and accurate claim submission, payment posting, and reconciliation.
* Review AR weekly, follow up on outstanding balances, and update deposit and tracking sheets.
* Analyze and resolve claim denials, rejections, and underpayments.  
  Perform charge validation, charge corrections, and ongoing data integrity checks.

### **Financial Tracking & Reporting**

* Update and maintain:

  + Monthly trended hours for Contract Fulfillment and Accounting.
  + Monthly payments and revenue summaries for Accounting.
* Prepare AR, revenue, and payer performance reports for leadership and CF review prior to billing.
* Track payer performance, denial trends, and reimbursement timelines.

### **Funder Relations and Contract Development**

* Contact funders to establish and manage Single Case Agreements (SCAs).
* Communicate with potential funders to explore and pursue new contracting opportunities.
* Build and maintain positive, professional relationships with funder representatives.
* Follow up consistently throughout the contracting and agreement process.
* Ensure Single Case Agreements and new contracts follow all payer, organizational, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track the status of agreements, outreach, and contracting opportunities.

### **Audit, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Prepare and support insurance audits, internal audits, FSO audits, and charge validations.
* Own audit preparation processes, documentation, and follow-ups.
* Ensure compliance with payer, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead discharge process review and billing closure.

### **Systems & Process Ownership**

* Own and maintain billing workflows across NPA and SimplePractice.
* Support appointment verification, billing readiness, and system troubleshooting.
* Identify inefficiencies, risks, or breakdowns in billing workflows and implement improvements.
* Develop, document, and refine SOPs for billing and AR processes.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary billing partner to:

  + Clinical Team
  + Contract Fulfillment Team
  + Accounting  
    Admin and Operations
* Provide guidance and support to teams regarding billing requirements, documentation, and timing.
* Support with co-pay and co-insurance billing and follow-ups.  
  Support teams with client billing inquiries, payment plans, and billing education.

### **Client & Payer Communication**

* Handle escalated client and payer billing inquiries professionally and ethically.
* Communicate with payers and clients regarding pending claims, discrepancies, and resolutions.
* Maintain a high standard of service, professionalism, and confidentiality.

**Requirements**
----------------

* High school diploma or GED required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Reliable internet, personal work computer, and a professional remote work environment.
* Ability to work 9:00 am – 5:30 pm Pacific Time, with flexibility to work evenings during peak periods.
* Ability to work consistently within the Pacific Time Zone.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience in medical billing or accounts receivable.
* Experience in an ABA or behavioral health setting strongly preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, tracking).
* Experience with billing systems and EHRs (NPA, SimplePractice, or similar).
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.  
  Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

**Why Choose BTS?**

At BTS, you’ll find a long-term career with mentorship, training, and growth opportunities. We collaborate with compassion and respect individuality, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive and grow.

**Pay & Benefits**

* 6 paid holidays after one year of employment
* Accrued Sick time
* Shadowing opportunities and hands-on mentorship to build confidence
* **Medical, dental, and vision** insurance (for employees working 30+ hrs/week)
* **401(k)** retirement plan, for those who have accrued 1000 hours of service within 12 months.
* **Aflac** supplemental insurance options (for employees working 30+ hrs/week)
* **LifeCare Employee Assistance Program:** includes free confidential counseling, referrals, and wellness resources
* **LifeMart Employee Discount Program:** exclusive savings on everyday purchases and services

### **About Us**

**BTS is a leader in Behavioral and Mental Health care and a pillar in the communities we serve.** We are a privately owned agency based in California. Founded in 2015 by a BCBA and a Marriage and Family Therapist, we serve children and families across multiple counties through behavior therapy, family support, and skill-building programs.

ffb63af5c01f3e1e2a30.title: Customer Service Representative- Remote
ffb63af5c01f3e1e2a30.description:
**What’s Under the Hood**

DriveTime Family of Brands includes SilverRock, which provides quality warranty and ancillary products, and a customer-friendly claims process. SilverRock offers a variety of ancillary products and administrative services encompassing everything from GAP coverage to vehicle theft and GPS tracking to dealership fleet management. Our ancillary product expertise is proven with over 1 million service contracts, products, and warranties, and over $300 million in claims.

**That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?**

In short, the SilverRock Customer Service Representative is responsible for inbound and outbound phone calls where you’ll be educating and answering questions regarding the customer's warranty.
  
  
In long, at SilverRock, we set out to simplify the overly complex and frustrating world of automotive warranties. We explore ways to anticipate customer needs by evolving our self-service options while staying true to our goal of providing world-class customer service. We believe that this is achieved by hiring masters of customer service that have high emotional intelligence to navigate customer interactions and know how to effectively manage customer conflict while in a fast-paced call center environment.

**So, What Kind of Folks Are We Looking for?**

* **Passionate and goal-oriented**. We are looking for someone that is enthusiastic about their career and is passionate about meeting and exceeding their goals.
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills**. The ability to talk and write with confidence, charisma, and competence to a wide variety of audiences.
* **Agile in a fast-paced environment**. We move, and we move quickly. Thriving in and contributing to an environment that never stops is a must.
* **Plays well with others**. You will be working in a high-functioning team environment. We work together and we win together.
* **Works well in a time crunch**. There will be multiple time-sensitive requirements and you will need the ability to meet deliverable due dates.
* **Fantastic problem solver!** Some calls will be challenging. Your goal is not only to find the problem but more importantly, find the solution.
* **Positive emotional resilience.** This is an environment where you will be faced with challenging calls on a daily basis. We want to make sure you have the ability to rise past them while maintaining an optimistic attitude.

**The Specifics.**

* High School diploma required; Associate or Bachelor’s degree is preferred
* 3+ years of experience working in a customer service role with conflict resolution.
* Since we talk about cars all day long, experience in the automotive industry is a **huge plus!** Exposure to vehicle repair shop procedures and practices, including labor guides and part pricing is preferred.
* Work from home - Feel free to rock the casual wear while still being camera ready. You will be working from your home office (in an approved city & state) and make sure you have a conducive and quiet workspace with no distractions and reliable and secure internet.
* ***Must be located in AZ, FL, GA, NC, TN, TX, UT or NV.***

**So What About the Perks? Perks matter**

* **Work From Home.** Feel free to rock the casual wear while still being camera ready. You will be working from your home office (in an approved city & state) and make sure you have a conducive and quiet workspace with no distractions and reliable and secure internet.
* **Medical, dental, and vision, oh my!** DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage.
* **But Wait, There’s More.** 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few.
* **Growth Opportunities.** You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year.
* **Tuition Reimbursement.** We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is.
* **Wellness Program.** Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!
* **Gratitude is Green.** We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters!
* **Consistent Work Schedule.** You’ll get a set schedule Monday through Friday, with rotating Saturdays! With that, we do ask for some flexibility and overtime as needed.

* **Game Room.** Gimme a break – no, not a Kit Kat ad but we do have a ping-pong table, a pool table and other games if you ever need a break in your day.
* **In-House Gym.** We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day, or finish strong with a workout!
* **Enjoy Social Events?** Bring it on. Rally with your team for festive gatherings, team competitions or just to hang out!
* **We Care and Value YOU!** Feel the love and let us treat you to company outings, personal rewards, amazing prizes & much more!
* **Paid Time Off.** Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

**Anything Else? Absolutely.**

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.

And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

**A path for every ambition.**

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.

We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

Your ambition has a home here.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an empathetic, detail-oriented, and professional **Client Services Representative** to support our life insurance policyholders and financial agents. In this role, the associate will act as the **primary point of contact** for client inquiries, policy changes, and initial claims processing. The associate's goal is to deliver a seamless, high-touch customer experience while navigating complex administrative guidelines and maintaining strict data privacy standards. **No prior life insurance experience is required; we will fully train the right candidate.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Inbound Request Management:** Serve as the primary contact handling phone calls, emails, and digital requests from clients and financial agents regarding ownership changes, beneficiary updates, address changes, and inforce illustration requests.
* **Premium Oversight & Follow-Up:** Monitor premium due dates, issue timely reminder notices to clients, and proactively coordinate carrier follow-ups to prevent policy lapses.
* **Data Management & Documentation:** Obtain accurate policy values, update the **SmartOffice CRM** platform with high precision, and maintain organized digital client records.
* **Reporting & Communications:** Generate, review, and compile formal Summary of Insurance reports and securely distribute them to clients and agents.
* **Compliance & Data Privacy:** Adhere strictly to industry regulations and financial data privacy standards when handling sensitive personal information.
* **Problem Resolution:** Troubleshoot complex administrative discrepancies by collaborating internally and communicating clear solutions back to policyholders.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in retail, hospitality, administrative support, or standard call center environments. **Prior insurance background is not required.**
* **Technical Aptitude:** Strong comfort level learning new software systems. Experience with standard Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and any CRM or database software is preferred.
* **Coachability & Drive:** A desire to learn a new industry with the ability to absorb, retain, and apply complex administrative guidelines during training.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a natural ability to speak with clients empathetically and professionally.
* **Attention to Detail:** Proven ability to manage high-volume data entry with minimal errors, ensuring records are kept accurately.
* **Education:** High school diploma or equivalent required; an Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree is a plus but not mandatory.

**SALARY TRANSPARENCY:**

*The expected salary range for this position is* $30-34/hr *and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HAS and 401(k) accounts, paid-time-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.*

**What we offer you**

We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career.

* Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching and company-paid life and disability plans
* Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance
* A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career

**The HUB difference**

HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** HUB International Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

  

**Reasonable Accommodations:** HUB International Limited is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to access our career site, complete an application, or participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact the Recruiting Team at HUBRecruiting@HUBInternational.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and should not be used to inquire about the status of an application.

**E-Verify:** HUB International Limited participates in E-Verify. Please refer to Our Recruiting Process | Applicant Notices: E-Verify Program for additional information.

**Department: Sales**

**Summary**

The Sales Support Representative position is responsible for managing customer relationships, supporting sales with quotes and orders, and ensuring accuracy and compliance throughout the process. You will coordinate installation projects to ensure timely delivery and collaborate with multiple departments to ensure seamless operations. In addition, you will maintain organized customer account documentation, respond to inquiries via telephone and e-mail, and resolve both routine and more complex customer issues. You will communicate solutions, provide requested information, and analyze customer service needs, referring them to other service or technical departments for further follow-up when necessary.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work closely with Sales, as well as Purchasing, Production, Shipping and Accounting to ensure customer’s expectations are being met and/or exceeded.
* Support Sales with the creation and processing of all customer quotes and orders.

* Organize electronic file structure on all customer accounts to defined management standards.
* Assist in the definition and implementation of process maps when needed.
* Manage installation project documentation, including creating and distributing Statements of Work (SOWs) to Production and Shipping.

* Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing at all levels of external and internal customer organizations.
