d8396ecbb60e85154817.title: Care Coordinator Specialist
d8396ecbb60e85154817.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

**Must be able to work in Eastern standard time zone or Central.**

The Care Coordination Specialist works under RN supervision to provide coordinated care services for injured workers with low to moderate complexity claims. This position ensures continuity of medical services and facilitates communication between all parties involved while supporting return-to-work efforts within workers' compensation guidelines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Care Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate routine medical care needs for assigned injured workers under established protocols
* Facilitate communication between injured workers, providers, employers, and adjusters for straightforward cases
* Collect and document clinical information from healthcare providers and claimants
* Schedule and coordinate medical appointments, diagnostics, and ancillary services
* Communicate work status updates to injured workers, employers, and claims adjusters

**Case Management Support**

* Follow established care plans and treatment protocols under RN supervision
* Monitor injured worker adherence to treatment plans and compare progress to established guidelines
* Maintain accurate documentation of medical history and case progress in WC system using approved formats
* Facilitate return-to-work efforts through coordination with employers and providers
* Escalate cases to RN supervision when clinical complexity increases beyond the scope

**Administrative Functions**

* Maintain and update case review notes and documentation on all assigned cases
* Complete time management tracking on all cases
* Attend team meetings and training sessions as scheduled
* Ensure cost containment through the utilization of in-network providers when appropriate
* Support network provider coordination efforts

**COMPETENCIES**

* Professional communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
* Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek supervision
* Understanding of confidentiality requirements and HIPAA guidelines
* Basic analytical skills for routine case assessment
* Adaptability in a fast-paced work environment
* Technology proficiency for case management systems and Microsoft Office applications

Qualifications:

**Education & Licensure:**

  

* High School Diploma required
* Graduate of an accredited practical/vocational nursing program
* Current compact LPN/LVN license in good standing

**Experience:**

* 2+ years of clinical experience required
* Workers' compensation or disability management experience is highly preferred
* Healthcare coordination and documentation experience preferred

**Skills:**

* Demonstrated organizational, technological, and communication skills
* Basic understanding of disability management principles
* Computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel), keyboard skills, and data entry capabilities

**PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:**

* Manage assigned caseload of low to moderate complexity workers' compensation claims
* Achieve established metrics for routine case resolution and return-to-work outcomes
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation per department standards
* Escalate cases appropriately when clinical complexity exceeds the scope of practice
* Demonstrate professional growth through continuing education and training participation
* Support team objectives and departmental goals

**SUPERVISION & REPORTING**

Works under the direct supervision of the RN Case Manager or the WC Nurse Supervisor. Receives guidance on complex cases and clinical decision-making. Expected to work independently on routine coordination tasks while maintaining regular communication with the supervising RN.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $18.23 - $28.85 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Project Specialist serves as the lead technical or operational point of contact for an assigned area of specialty and provides technical and administrative support to field and Operations staff. The position supports the assignment, setup, communication, scheduling, coordination, preparation, and completion of assigned project tasks. The Project Specialist applies knowledge of applicable technical standards, client requirements, and established protocols; identifies and communicates project findings and issues; and provides guidance within the assigned area of expertise. The position primarily supports internal stakeholders in delivering client programs accurately, on time, and in accordance with applicable quality standards.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Serves as a primary technical or operational resource for the assigned area of specialty, as further defined in the applicable division- and role-specific responsibilities.

* Provides technical and administrative support for the assignment, setup, scheduling, coordination, preparation, and completion of assigned project tasks.

* Reviews and interprets project information and applies applicable technical standards, client requirements, company procedures, and established protocols to assigned work.

* Coordinates and communicates project requirements, status, findings, outstanding items, and identified issues with clients, management, employees, vendors, subcontractors, and other applicable stakeholders.

* Monitors the progress and quality of assigned project tasks, identifies project-related issues, and resolves or escalates those issues within established responsibilities and procedures.

* Provides technical guidance and assistance to employees and other project resources within the assigned area of specialty.

* Coordinates project-related activities performed by staff, vendors, subcontractors, or other resources assigned to the work, without implying formal supervisory authority unless separately assigned.

* Prepares, reviews, coordinates, or supports technical documents, reports, correspondence, and other project deliverables applicable to the assigned specialty.

* Enhances professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies.

* Complies with federal, state and local legal requirements by studying new and existing legislation, anticipating future legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, and advising management on necessary action.

* Upholds industry and company standards by providing guidance on technical issues.

* Maintains open communication with management and staff regarding departmental and operational matters.

* Provides training, mentoring, and technical assistance to new and existing employees, as assigned.

* Delivers outstanding customer service through timely response and proactive solutions to clients and stakeholder needs.

* Protects operations by keeping company information confidential. Use of professional discretion and judgment is mandatory.

* Demonstrates BV’s guiding principles in support of the company's strategic goals.

* Follows all documented policies, Standard Operating Procedures, and Work Instructions applicable to the position and support of BV's quality standards and strategic initiatives.

* Maintains safe and clean work area by complying with all procedures, rules, and regulations.

* Must be able to meet the physical demands of the job.

**Role Specific Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Primary lead for vendor/subcontractor management, training and documentation programs, and workload monitoring activities in support of departmental objectives.

* Develops and manages qualified subcontractor network that supports program delivery, with a thorough understanding of regional coverage needs, capacity demands, and vendor qualification requirements.

* Serves as the primary resource for surveyor and vendor network management by proactively identifying sourcing risks, geographic coverage deficiencies, capacity limitations, performance concerns, and cost impacts, and implementing solutions to maintain a reliable provider network.

* Develops and maintains processes for monitoring vendor performance, collecting internal feedback regarding quality and responsiveness concerns, investigating declines in vendor participation or bid activity, and communicating findings and performance expectations to vendors to improve engagement and service delivery.

* Maintains and analyzes vendor performance metrics, including responsiveness, quality, capacity, pricing, and geographic coverage, and provides recommendations for continuous improvement of the vendor network.

* Serves as a key relationship manager for the surveyor and vendor network, building strong partnerships through proactive communication, resolution of operational challenges, and collaboration to improve proposal participation, service quality, responsiveness, and competitive fee structures.

* Owns the onboarding and compliance management of vendors in all BV Systems (e.g., FLEX, nTel and Vision).

* Coordinates and maintains the Land Survey onboarding and training program, serving as a trainer and mentor to new employees while developing, maintaining, and improving training materials, procedures, and departmental documentation.

* Provides operational support to Project Managers during periods of increased workload, employee absences, or changing business demands. Support activities may include proposal coordination, vendor management, survey review and revision coordination, and portfolio administration within the scope of the Project Specialist's assigned responsibilities and expertise.

* Supports execution of workload distribution strategies established by the Program Manager by monitoring work assignments, identifying potential resource constraints, communicating workload concerns, and coordinating adjustments as directed.

* Provides portfolio reporting, workload tracking, and operational analysis to support Program and Business Leaders in managing active work and portfolio opportunities.

* Supports adherence to company procedures, client requirements, and industry standards through the consistent application of approved processes and operational best practices.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

This job does not have specific supervisory responsibilities. Role may require indirect mentorship and training responsibilities to inexperienced staff under the direction/instruction of the Program or Business Leader. Responsibilities include training employees, planning, assigning, and quality controlling completed work.

**Skills**
----------

* Language Ability: Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and standard operating procedures. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from clients, peers, and technical field staff.
* Reasoning Ability: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of instructions and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Technology Skills: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be proficient in operating a computer, having knowledge of word processing software, spreadsheet software, and project management software.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Ability to motivate, develop, and direct people
* Time management skills
* Active listening skills
* Critical thinking skills
* Problem solving skills
* Oral and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment

**Education, Certifications, and Experience**
---------------------------------------------

*Education and/or Experience**:*

* Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university in related field; minimum of five years of related experience. In lieu of degree, eight years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

*Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:*

Employees who incur less than $2,000 per year in company-related travel expenses will be required to have sufficient personal credit to cover their business travel costs.

**Physical and Environmental Conditions**
-----------------------------------------

*While performing the office/offsite duties of this job**, the employee is required to:*

* Operate a computer (up to 100% of workweek)
* Regularly required to use hands.
* Repetitive use of hands/fingers for keyboard interaction (frequently)
* Talk and hear
* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk and hear.
* Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* The noise level in the home or company office environment is usually quiet.
* Ability to successfully work from remote location.

**Travel Requirement**
----------------------

This is intended to be a remote position not requiring regular travel. There may be times where travel by plane, motor vehicle, train to client sites/project sites across the U.S. is required.

**Benefits**

**VIVO Infusion - Infusion Insurance Specialist (Patient Access Specialist)**

**Hybrid/Remote**

**Compensation:**

* Pay Range: $24.00 - $26.00/Hour
* Bonus Plan Target: 5% Annually (Based on performance)

  + HSA w/ Employer Contribution
  + Touchcare - Insurance Concierge Service

* PTO: Accrual 3+ weeks
  + PTO Buy-back, PTO Rollover, and PTO Donation Program.
* Wellness Reimbursement Program - $360 Annually
* Employee Referral Bonus - Uncapped Bonus Potential
* Tuition Assistance Program & Professional Association Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (Employer-provided)
* Short & long-term disability (Employer-provided)
* Life Insurance (Employer-provided)

**Employment Type, Schedule, FLSA Status:**

* Full-time
* Position Schedule:
  + Monday-Friday | Flexible hours 7:00am - 7:00pm EST
* Non-Exempt

**Reports to:** Patient Access Director

**Location:**

* **The Patient Access Specialist will work remotely from a home office with a secure network. Only candidates residing in the states below at the time of employment will be able to be considered. Travel with Vivo equipment is not permitted without prior approval.**

  Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Nevada, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Washington D.C.

As the **Infusion Insurance Specialist**, known internally as a **Patient Access Specialist**, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Intake Process. You will collaborate with the Revenue Operations Lead and Manager to ensure thorough processing of referrals and patient scheduling. In this position you will also provide excellent customer service, gathering insurance authorizations and eligibility verifications. The individual is responsible for prioritizing, organizing, and completing assigned responsibilities and tasks in a timely manner.

**For this position, applicants must have the following experience:**

* 2 years of experience working in high-volume insurance verification, benefits, and eligibility/authorizations.
* 2 years of medical billing and authorizations or managing physician referrals.
* 1 year experience working in a customer service or patient facing role.

### **Primary role responsibilities:**

* *Insurance Verification & Benefits and Authorizations*
* Verify insurance eligibility and benefits for new and existing patients receiving infusion therapy and injectable medications, utilizing payer web portals (e.g., Availity, UHC Provider Portal) and direct payer contact as needed
* Coordinate benefits (COB) across primary, secondary, and tertiary payers
* Maintain working knowledge of all insurance contracts for assigned clinics and regions
* Update patient accounts with current insurance information and ensure records remain accurate and current
* Submit prior authorization requests (medical benefits) for infusion therapy via phone, fax, and payer web portals, and follow up to ensure timely determination
* Maintain authorization renewals for existing patients to ensure continuity of care
* Manage initial insurance denials and appeals specific to infusion therapy, including drafting clinical justification and coordinating with provider offices for supporting documentation
* Apply working knowledge of applicable CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes to authorization submissions
* Referral & Documentation Management
* Submit and follow up on PCP referral requests to ensure timely processing and continuity of care
* Review, identify, and compile medical records required for benefits verification and authorization
* Manage incoming eFax and email correspondence
* Ensure referral packets and supporting documentation are scanned and stored in the appropriate EMR location
* Document referral progress and account updates in the referral tracking platform
* Review and process order updates as they are received
* Perform data entry and participate in accuracy audits
* Existing Patient Operations
* Review daily and weekly schedules for insurance eligibility, active authorizations, and current annual financial documents
* Identify and resolve issues that could disrupt continuity of care, such as expired authorizations, inactive insurance, or outdated documentation
* Communication & Collaboration
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication when interacting with payers, referring office staff, patients, physicians, and internal teams, representing Vivo professionally in every interaction
* Coordinate with Clinical Operations and any necessary Patient Services teams — including Patient Care, Medical Policy, Patient Resources, and Specialty Pharmacy coordinators — on referral documentation, COB concerns, patient financial documents, authorizations, and renewals
* Use approved templates, naming conventions, formats, and distribution lists for all system notations and email or task communication
* Performance
* Meet departmental productivity, quality, and turnaround time standards as established by Patient Services leadership

**Secondary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Assist with departmental projects as assigned, including account audits, system updates, data entry and reconciliation, acquisition support, and the annual reverification project
* Maintain working knowledge of the referral tracking platform and the core EMR
* Maintain patient records and confidentiality via the electronic medical record system in accordance with HIPAA guidelines and all applicable Vivo policies
* Attend all required meetings related to organizational, departmental, team, and individual performance
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **Qualifications:**

* Education:
  + High school graduate or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience:
  + Experience with major medical health insurance benefits verification, prior authorization, and appeals for buy-and-bill infusion therapy and injectable medications strongly preferred.
  + Minimum 2-3 years of related prior work experience required, preferably in the healthcare industry.
  + Proven competencies can take precedence over prior work experience.
  + Knowledge of Medicare & commercial/private insurance benefits, medical authorizations, HIPAA, and medical abbreviations and terminology preferred.
  + Prior experience working with sensitive information and maintaining confidentiality.
* Skills:
  + Proficient (intermediate level of application) with all Microsoft Office Products programs.
  + Must possess outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, be able to communicate professionally and effectively with other staff members, patients, vendors, and physicians, and is fluent in written and spoken English.
  + Experience supporting multiple managers/supervisors.

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

### **Who We Are:**

The Vivo Infusion team is focused on providing patients with the highest quality of care in a comfortable, safe, and convenient setting! Vivo is a national company with locations in 15 states, providing opportunities for growth and advancement as well as competitive benefits that support what matters most to you.

Our highly trained medical professionals are dedicated to delivering a safe, comfortable, and affordable solution for our patients. We offer an array of advanced therapeutics and provide personalized, care for every patient. These treatments are delivered by a highly-skilled, clinical nursing staff and monitored by board-certified advanced practitioners.

### **Vivo Infusion has received The Gold Seal of Approval® from The Joint Commission.**

The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval is a nationally recognized distinction voluntarily earned by a select set of healthcare providers.

An organization that achieves The Gold Seal of Approval® shows its commitment to holding itself accountable to a high bar for quality and safety for those they serve.

Learn more about Vivo, by visiting our website: https://vivoinfusion.com/

**Work Environment & Physical Demands:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

The employee is frequently required to sit for long periods. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit, talk, type, and hear. Requires excellent visual dexterity and manual dexterity.

23266f1f3a8c62863fda.title: eCornell Director, Enterprise Programs - Northeast (Remote)
23266f1f3a8c62863fda.description:
**APPLY**
---------

**The Opportunity**

eCornell is seeking a high-performing **Director, Enterprise Programs** to expand strategic partnerships with leading organizations and drive enterprise learning solutions that create measurable business impact.

  
  

In this highly consultative business development role, you will engage senior executives and enterprise decision-makers to identify workforce development needs and align them with Cornell University's world-class online education offerings. This includes eCornell's professional certificate programs, OnDemand solutions, and customized learning opportunities across Cornell's colleges and executive education units

  
  

If you are a proven enterprise sales professional who thrives on building relationships, opening new opportunities, and driving revenue growth, we invite you to join our team.

  
  

**This remote-based position requires the employee to reside within the Northeast territory, preferably in New York, to effectively support client engagement, business development activities, and regional responsibilities.**

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and grow a robust enterprise sales pipeline across an assigned territory.

* Prospect and engage Fortune 1000 organizations and other large employers.

* Build strategic account plans that identify growth opportunities and accelerate revenue generation.

* Collaborate closely with internal sales and program teams to execute successful account strategies.

* Conduct executive-level discovery conversations to uncover workforce development and talent needs.

* Design customized learning solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

* Present to C-suite and senior leadership audiences.

* Position eCornell's offerings as scalable solutions that drive employee development, leadership growth, and organizational performance.

* Manage a designated enterprise territory with responsibility for achieving and exceeding revenue goals.

* Execute strategic sales plans to deliver quarterly and annual bookings targets.

* Negotiate pricing, scope, and contract terms to secure mutually beneficial partnerships.

* Manage an anticipated revenue portfolio in excess of $2 million annually.

* Maintain accurate sales activity, opportunity, and account information in Salesforce.

* Deliver regular pipeline and forecast reporting.

* Use data and market intelligence to inform strategy and maximize performance.

  

**About the Department**

As Cornell University’s online learning unit, eCornell delivers online professional certificate courses to individuals and organizations around the world. Courses are personally developed by Cornell faculty with expertise in a wide range of topics, including data analytics, management, marketing, human resources, leadership, and STEM. Students learn in an interactive, small cohort format to gain skills they can immediately apply in their organizations, while earning a professional certificate from Cornell University. eCornell has offered online learning courses and certificate programs for 15 years to over 130,000 students at more than 2,000 companies.

  

**What We Need**

* Bachelor's degree and 5 to 10+ years of experience in business development, enterprise sales, marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Demonstrated record of success in a quota-carrying, goal-oriented sales environment.

* Experience selling leadership development, eLearning, executive education, professional development, training, professional services, or consulting solutions.

* Proven success engaging and influencing C-suite executives.

* Outstanding presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

* Self-motivated, organized, and highly results-oriented.

* Experience using Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

* Ability to work collaboratively across teams while independently managing a territory and pipeline.
  

  

**Incentive Program:**
  
This position offers a salary range of $91,153 to $111,410, commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, you will be eligible to participate in a performance-based incentive program in accordance with the **eCornell Corporate Programs Plan** (“Plan”) parameters. As a Director of Enterprise Programs, you will be eligible to earn a target of $120,000 in variable compensation based on annual sales quotas in your assigned territory.

  
  

**Rewards and Benefits**

* This position is based in Ithaca, New York, however, the successful applicant may perform this role remotely anywhere within the United States. Employees who work remotely may receive multiple W-2 Forms depending on their work location.
* The New York Convenience of employer guidelines require New York State individual tax reporting and withholding for this position. Additional individual state income tax filings may also be required if working temporarily outside of New York State.
* Cornell receives national recognition as an award-winning workplace for our health, wellbeing, and sustainability. Our benefits programs include comprehensive health care options, generous retirement contributions, access to wellness programs, and employee discounts with local and national retail brands. We invite you to follow this link to get more information about our benefits: Understand Your Benefits | Working at Cornell.

  

* Our leave provisions include health and personal leave, three weeks of vacation and 13 holidays: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, and an end of the year winter break from December 25-January 1. To offer greater flexibility for observing faiths and traditions we also offer two additional floating holidays. Learn more about our generous leave provisions: Holiday and Accrued Time Off | Working at Cornell

  

* Cornell's impressive educational benefits include tuition-free Extramural Study and Employee Degree Program, tuition aid for external education, and Cornell Children's Tuition Assistance Program. Learn more about our extensive educational benefits: Education Benefits | Working at Cornell

  

* Follow this link to learn more about the Total Rewards of Working at Cornell: Total Rewards | Working at Cornell.

  

***Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.***

d9cd418ac163513ccf1e.title: Associate Clinical Specialist - Cardiac Rhythm Management - Chicagoland
d9cd418ac163513ccf1e.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 21 Oct 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.  

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**

Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.

This role supports the Chicagoland territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.

To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Provide** technical support for CRM devices and therapies by performing system checks/interrogations, supporting implants, troubleshooting issues, and applying knowledge gained through comprehensive CRM field training.

* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.

* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.

* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.

* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.

* **Maintain** technical expertise by staying current on new CRM products, therapies, solutions, and patient management offerings to effectively support customers and clinical outcomes.

* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time

* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.

* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

* **Performs** other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma PLUS a minimum 4 years **OR** associate's degree PLUS a minimum 2 years' work experience in healthcare, field sales, or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science or computing **OR** Bachelor’s Degree

**NICE TO HAVE - DESIRED/PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, life sciences, biomedical engineering  



For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 17 Oct 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.  

Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.

This role supports the Iowa City territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.

To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.

* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.

* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.

* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.

* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time

* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.

* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

12f695f536b646654c00.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

SOLV Energy is looking for a Software QA and Support Engineer to join our Software Engineering Team to ensure we are providing high-quality work and service to our (mostly internal) customers. We are seeking someone who will collaborate within the team to successfully coordinate with external teams, test our software solutions, and contribute to our culture of continuous improvement and growth.
  
  
Members of the Software Engineering team support our custom software for utility-scale construction management, data monitoring, analytics, and reporting.
  
  
This role is fully remote, or hybrid with regular office presence in San Diego, CA or Bend, Oregon. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Achieve an expert level understanding of our custom software system features, the design intent, integrations with other business platforms, and how the applications are utilized
* Prioritize and manage testing work independently using Jira, team tools, and release timelines
* Build understanding of intended feature behavior through self-directed exploration and direct coordination with developers and product team members
* Work together with other QA team members to coordinate functional, regression, negative, and ad-hoc testing
* Write comprehensive test cases to cover functional test scenarios
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve testing through automation, AI, and other innovations
* Build self-sufficiency in your test environment, including basic Git/GitHub skills to pull and run code locally
* Bring insights from training and communications to the Software Engineering team to support continuous process and product improvement
* Serve as first point of contact and 2nd-tier support for our custom software — troubleshoot and resolve where possible, or escalate to the Development Manager with a clear, reproducible bug report in Jira
* Monitor support channels and maintain clear, accurate ticket records from intake through resolution, meeting response-time expectations
* Identify recurring or common issues, document known fixes to reduce repeat tickets and support future self-service, and suggest improvements to address root causes
* Complete other responsibilities as assigned

**Key Competencies:**

* Demonstrated, exceptional organizational skills and an aptitude to learn
* Experience testing software applications, identifying bugs, validating features against product requirements
* Proficiency in Jira and Confluence
* Strong problem-solving ability and analytical skills
* Clear and concise communication resulting in the contribution to effective wikis, product requirements
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience providing end-user software support, including triage, troubleshooting, and ticket management
* Comfortable being the front-line contact for support requests, with a customer- service mindset
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent support requests without losing track of details

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* B.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, or related
* Experience writing automated tests for Typescript or Python code bases
* 5+ years of software QA testing

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary

7c091a0b196586faf7f3.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
7c091a0b196586faf7f3.description:
Synergy Business Innovation & Solutions is a premier implementer of cutting-edge software solutions. Synergy brings the experience and expertise necessary to deliver capability that provides tangible ROI to our customers. Our core areas of expertise are in the fields of Digital Transformation, Cloud Solutions, SaaS and Low-Code/No-Code Solutions, Emerging Technologies, Data Analytics and Visualization, Information Assurance, and Business Process Re-Engineering.

Synergy offers its employees a generous portfolio of core and voluntary benefits including: group medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k) with company match, PTO & Bonus Leave, 11 paid federal holidays, parental leave, tuition and training reimbursement, a referral bonus program, and well-being programs.

At Synergy, you’ll be challenged and given the opportunity to grow in your career path. In fact, growth is such a big deal to us that we have career mentors available for every employee, company-funded certification opportunities, education reimbursement, and a general open-door policy so that you have support when you need it. Our team is eager to learn, fast-paced, and quality-driven. If that sounds like you, Synergy has a position for you!

This position is designated as work-from-home.

**About the Role:**

Synergy is seeking a Quality Assurance Analyst/Tester. As a Quality Assurance Analyst, you will be performing functional testing and Integration Tests via a server-based application User Interface. The right candidate will have a working knowledge of software engineering concepts such as software development standards, quality assurance standards, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). As a Quality Assurance Analyst you will be able to interpret requirements, develop test plans and test cases, and test software functionality. The role will ensure quality in the product development and participate in client engagements, along with improving product quality assurance practices and supporting business development activities.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Expert Software Quality Assurance Analyst.
* Provides technical leadership to junior QA analysts.
* Expert with testing tools and methodologies.
* Meeting with the software/product designers to determine quality assurance parameters.
* Defines test plan development guidelines, testing strategies and procedures.
* Exercises extensive professional experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals.
* Ensuring the successful deployment of products into production with minimal deficiencies.
* Responding to requests from the design team and management.
* Support application deployments, testing activities, and production releases.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, architects, QA testers, and product stakeholders.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, testing artifacts, and implementation guides.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Assist in mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge across the scrum team.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience with functional, system, regression, and integration testing.
* Proven experience developing test cases from user stories.
* Ability to analyze a product for accurate Integration test scenarios.
* High-level analytical skills and a high level of attention to detail.
* Critical thinker.
* Proven experience with test management tools.
* Experience with a variety of SDLC and Agile methodologies required.
* Experience in testing of RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs, and/or web services.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to multi-task under tight deadlines and report status.
* Ability to document QA procedures for the team.
* Ability to validate the deployment of software releases.
* Proven experience in test planning (including data planning), test scheduling, and test evaluation.
* Management of defects within a corporate defect tracking system.
* Ability to obtain Security + Certification, if necessary.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams including New Development and Production Support for field level incidents.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative Agile team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform.
* Experience with model-driven apps in Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Experience using Jira.
* Experience supporting production applications and participating in troubleshooting and incident resolution activities.

**Education Requirements:**

* Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Citizenship & Clearance Requirements:**

* Required: US Citizen w/ Public Trust or ability to achieve Public Trust.

**Target Salary Range**

Compensation for roles at Synergy is determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the requirements of the role; level of experience; education and certifications; the individual’s combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities; as well as alignment with market data, federal and state laws, and other business and contract considerations. The estimated pay range for this position is: $80,000.00 – $95,000.00. The disclosed range has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case and represent just one component of Synergy’s total compensation package for employees.

**Candidate AI Policy**

Synergy is committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate evaluation process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly granted.** You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

***Synergy is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants for employment or its employees on the basis of age, race (including hair texture/style), creed, color, religion, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, sex, medical condition, pregnancy (childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), physical or mental disability, personal appearance, organ donation and hair length associated with race, genetic information or characteristics, family responsibilities, familial status, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sexual offense, or stalking, political affiliation, arrest records and criminal convictions, credit information, matriculation, homeless status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local law. Discrimination or harassment based upon these protected categories is expressly prohibited. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including job selection, assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline, and termination.***

08aad90411485e80ebab.title: Tax Reporting Test Analyst (CONTRACT) REMOTE
08aad90411485e80ebab.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Broadridge is Growing! We are seeking a **Tax Reporting Test Analyst** with financial services experience to support testing activities related to tax reporting initiatives, system enhancements, and regulatory changes. This role will combine tax reporting knowledge with hands-on testing, data validation, reconciliation, and defect management. The ideal candidate will have experience working with tax reporting systems and financial-services data and be able to validate end-to-end results from source/history data through core processing, tax form boxes, and final reporting outputs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute QA and UAT test scenarios and test cases, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, dress rehearsal, and production-validation testing.
* Apply tax reporting knowledge to understand expected processing results, identify appropriate test scenarios, and validate system behavior.
* Review business, functional, and tax reporting requirements and translate them into comprehensive testing scenarios and expected results.
* Identify required test populations, test data, expected results, dependencies, prerequisite processing, and testing coverage.
* Validate end-to-end tax data processing from transaction/history data through core tables, business-rule processing, tax form box calculations, and final reporting outputs.
* Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation to identify discrepancies between source/history data, processed data, expected results, and tax reporting outputs.
* Use SQL and Excel to research data, develop test populations, validate results, reconcile large datasets, and investigate testing discrepancies.
* Validate source-to-target mappings, file layouts, data transformations, calculations, tax business rules, reference data, and system configuration.
* Validate tax forms and reporting outputs against source data, expected results, documented requirements, and applicable tax reporting rules.
* Execute positive, negative, boundary, exception, and regression testing to confirm system functionality and identify unintended impacts.
* Identify and document defects in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, supporting data, expected results, and actual results.
* Manage defects through analysis, remediation, retesting, regression testing, and closure.
* Partner with Development, Product, Operations, QA, UAT, and Tax teams to investigate and resolve tax reporting, testing, and data discrepancies.
* Track test execution, defects, blockers, dependencies, and outstanding items through resolution.
* Maintain test cases, test evidence, reconciliation results, defect documentation, and supporting documentation required for implementation and production readiness.
* Support annual tax-year changes, regulatory updates, system migrations, conversions, dress rehearsals, and production implementations.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in tax reporting, QA/UAT testing, tax data analysis, operations testing, or a similar role within financial services, with demonstrated experience combining tax domain knowledge and hands-on testing.
* Strong hands-on experience with QA and UAT testing, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, system-validation, and production-validation testing.
* Experience developing and executing detailed test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Experience performing end-to-end tax data testing across transaction/history data, core processing tables, tax form box calculations, and final reporting outputs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working with large datasets, reconciliations, exception analysis, and root-cause investigation.
* Proficiency with SQL and Microsoft Excel for data validation, reconciliation, research, and testing.
* Strong hands-on experience with JIRA is required, including creating and managing defects, documenting expected and actual results, tracking issues through resolution, supporting retesting, and maintaining testing status and evidence.
* Experience validating source-to-target mappings, data transformations, calculations, business rules, file layouts, reference data, and system configuration.
* Strong experience identifying, documenting, tracking, retesting, and closing defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting data.
* Experience working with or testing tax reporting systems or tax data platforms is strongly preferred.
* Experience with tax information reporting, including Forms 5498, 5498-ESA, 1042-S, and 1099 reporting, is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with retirement reporting, NRA reporting, income reporting, withholding, brokerage transactions, and securities processing is preferred.
* Experience within brokerage, wealth management, banking, securities processing, asset servicing, or financial reporting environments.
* Experience with large-volume data reconciliation and comparison testing.
* Ability to independently manage assigned QA/UAT testing activities, reconciliations, defects, and test evidence through completion.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project-delivery methodologies.

*Hourly range $60-70/hr*

b2ef2c23ec046a2ee35e.description:
Description:

**OVERVIEW**

The Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for managing customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices, applying customer payments, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining accurate accounts receivable records. This position works closely with Sales, Customer Service, Operations, and Accounting to support strong customer relationships, maintain accurate account information, and maximize cash flow while minimizing bad debt exposure.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable balancing collection efforts by maintaining positive, professional relationships with customers. Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills are important in this role. Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred.

Reporting structure

* Reports To: Accounting Manager / Controller
* Department: Finance & Accounting
* FLSA Status: Exempt

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Accounts Receivable Management**

* Generate, distribute, and monitor customer invoices.
* Apply customer payments accurately and timely.
* Reconcile customer accounts and research discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate accounts receivable records and supporting documentation.
* Process credits, deductions, and adjustments in accordance with company policies.

**Collections and Cash Management**

* Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and proactively follow up on overdue balances.
* Contact customers regarding past-due invoices through phone, email, and written correspondence.
* Recommend payment arrangements to management when appropriate.
* Escalate delinquent accounts to management in accordance with established procedures.
* Support cash flow objectives through timely and consistent collection activities.

**Customer Account Support**

* Respond to customer inquiries regarding invoices, statements, payments, and account balances.
* Research and resolve payment disputes, pricing discrepancies, and billing issues.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, and Operations to resolve customer concerns that may impact payment.
* Maintain positive, professional customer relationships while consistently enforcing established payment terms.

Requirements:

**Reporting and Analysis**

* Prepare accounts receivable aging reports and collection status updates.
* Identify trends related to delinquent accounts and customer payment activity.
* Assist with month-end closing activities and account reconciliations.
* Support internal and external audit requests as needed.
* Provide information and recommendations to management related to past-due receivables and collection activities.

**Process Improvement**

* Assist with maintaining and improving accounts receivable processes, controls, and procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, collection efficiency, and cash application processes.
* Support ERP system enhancements and other continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Manufacturing-Specific Experience**

* Understanding of customer purchase orders, sales orders, shipping documents, and invoicing processes.
* Familiarity with OEM, industrial, distribution, or contract manufacturing customers.
* Experience working with deductions related to freight claims, pricing disputes, returned goods, and quality issues.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as Epicor, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, IQMS, Plex, or Infor.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of accounts receivable principles and collection practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to analyze account activity and identify discrepancies.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to professionally handle sensitive customer interactions.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
* Percentage of past-due receivables
* Aging portfolio management

**Education**

* Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2-5 years of accounts receivable, collections, or accounting experience.
* Manufacturing industry experience preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems and accounting software.
* Experience managing a high-volume customer portfolio is preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Occasional lifting of office materials up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to communicate effectively by phone, video conference, and email.

**LOCATION**

* Remote - preference if located near one of our facilities

**SCHEDULE**

* M-F

**CADREX’S CORE VALUES**

* Safety first, rising to the challenge, collaboration, accountability, and doing the right thing

**ABOUT US**

CADREX Manufacturing Solutions is a leading provider of complex sheet metal and machined production parts, assemblies, and weldments for a variety of end markets, including electrical transmission and distribution, warehouse automation, technology, aerospace & defense, medical, food, and industrials. With locations in Colorado, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Washington, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Michigan, Indiana, Massachusetts, Oklahoma, and Monterrey Mexico, CADREX offers numerous in-house manufacturing capabilities, including laser cutting, sheet metal fabrication, complex assembly, CNC punching, CNC machining, forming, robotic welding, stamping, fastener insertion, and tool and die manufacturing, to effectively serve customers with lights-out manufacturing capabilities for mid- to high-volume production. For more information, visit www.cadrex.com.

215a4923a2f19add8d81.description:
**Syms Strategic Group (SSG)** is seeking a talented **Software Testing Principal (MUMPS)**  
**Location:** Remote  
**Department:** Veterans Affairs (VA)  
**Type:** Full Time  
**Min. Experience:** Experienced  
**Security Clearance Level:** Public Trust (MBI)  
**Salary Range:** $80,000 - $120,000  
***If you have previously applied to Syms Strategic Group (SSG), there is no need to reapply. Applications are still under review.***  
  
**Military Veterans are highly encouraged to apply!**  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

* Support testing and quality assurance activities for mission-critical healthcare applications operating in a MUMPS/InterSystems Cache environment
* Support modernization efforts, system enhancements, healthcare interoperability initiatives, and production support activities associated with legacy healthcare systems
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test procedures for healthcare applications operating in MUMPS/InterSystems Cache environments
* Validate software enhancements, maintenance releases, defect corrections, and system upgrades
* Support functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, system, and end-to-end testing activities
* Verify data integrity across legacy healthcare applications, databases, interfaces, and external systems
* Test healthcare interoperability transactions utilizing Health Level Seven (HL7), Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Electronic Data Interchanges (EDIs), and related industry standards
* Participate in Beta/IOC testing with healthcare facilities and end users, documenting results and coordinating issue resolution
* Analyze an troubleshoot software defects, integration failures, and production incidents
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and end users to valid requirements and test objectives
* Develop test data and test environments supporting healthcare workflows and business processes
* Execute manual and automated testing activities where applicable
* Track, document, and communicate testing metrics, defects, risks, and status reports
* Validate integrations involving Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA), FileMan, healthcare messaging platforms, and external partner systems
* Support root cause analysis and verification of software fixes
* Review system requirements and technical specifications to ensure testability and complete coverage
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, procedures, and quality standards
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on testing strategies for healthcare and government systems

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* Experience supporting healthcare, government, or other highly regulated environments
* Experience testing enterprise applications supporting clinical, benefits, or healthcare operations
* Experience supporting legacy applications and long-lived mission-critical systems
* Experience testing applications developed using MUMPS and/or InterSystems Cache
* Experience validating healthcare business workflows and system functionality
* Experience developing detailed test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases
* Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
* An understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies
* Experience validating database updates and data integrity
* An ability to analyze system logs, application errors, and test results to identify root causes
* Experience testing interfaces and system integrations
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7, FHIR, and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) EDI Transactions
* Experience validating EDI healthcare transactions, including 278 Prior Authorizations and 275 Attachments
* Experience utilizing defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), and TestRail
* Experience creating testing metrics, dashboards, and status reports
* Strong documentation skills
* Knowledge of healthcare operational workflows
* Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems
* Experience supporting VistA environments
* Experience testing FileMan database functionality
* An understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* An ability to work directly with business users and customers
* An ability to independently prioritize multiple activities
* Experience collaborating within cross-functional technical teams
* Strong attention to detail
* An ability to lead testing efforts and mentor junior testers
* Experience supporting production troubleshooting and issue resolution

  

**Professional Certifications**

n/a

  

**Years of Professional Experience**

10+ years of software testing, quality assurance, or system validation experience

  

**Desired experience**

Deep hands-on EDIFECS experience in Electronic Data Interchange X.12 (EDI) Transactions Standards involving key X12 workflows involving the following transactions:

* X.12 medical claims (837, 834, 835, 277, etc)
* 270/271 and 278/275 transactions
* 999 transactions

Experience with supporting Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA) and FileMan applications  
Advanced certifications, including (1) International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), (2) Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE), and/or (3) Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or similar testing certifications  
Test automation experience  
SQL/database validation experience  
Experience testing cloud-hosted healthcare apps  
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines  
Experience supporting modernization initiatives involving legacy healthcare systems  
Familiarity with federal healthcare programs and regulations

  

**Formal Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or related field

  

**Citizenship Requirement**

**U.S. Citizenship required for this specific opportunity**

  

**Security Clearance Requirements**

Must possess or qualify for a Public Trust (MBI)

  

**CRITICAL NOTES:**

* SSG will not make assumptions regarding your qualifications. Your answers to the mandatory screening questions must be supported by the information on your resume. Applications with inconsistencies will not be considered.
* Recruiters or Third parties will not be considered.
* This is a 100% U.S. based remote position. However, candidates from CA, CO, IL, MN, NJ, NY, OR, or WA will not be considered.
* This is a W-2 position
* All interviews will be conducted on Microsoft Teams with your camera on; there will be no exceptions
* As part of our screening process, you will be requested to provide a link to your LinkedIn profile

  
***U.S Citizenship is required for this specific opportunity***. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information and be able to obtain a government-granted security clearance. Individuals may also be subject to a background investigation including, but not limited to criminal history, employment and education verification, drug testing, and creditworthiness.  
  
Syms Strategic Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or genetic information.
