**Overview of Job Function:**

The Manager, Operations will be responsible for the overall Supply Chain Management including interfacing with business functions, procurement, sales, support, quality management and new product engineering. The role will manage day-to-day operations including forecasting material planning, warehousing, inventory management, distribution, customer services, and support. The role will manage relationships with suppliers, contractors and third-party service providers to the operations group. The manager also will oversee the entire order cycle and ensure sustainable operations and customer satisfaction. This role is a blend of primarily managing external supply chain operations, while also providing people leadership internally to operations specialists.

  

**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with leadership and business functions to drive operational activities and support business objectives.
* Evaluate overall performance by gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data and metrics.
* Direct inbound or outbound logistics operations, such as transportation optimization, warehouse activities, safety performance, or logistics quality management.
* Manage the daily fulfillment of customer shipments by working with Verint’s third party logistics service providers.
* Coordinate and communicate with planning, production, shipping, and procurement to meet order requirements and set priorities to achieve on-time delivery and maximize inventory.
* Regularly evaluate the efficiency of business procedures according to organizational objectives and identify/implement improvements.
* Own decisions and risks mitigators to execute on competing priorities and monitor specific supply chain-based Key Performance Measurement Matrix such as OTD (On Time Delivery), and MTTR (Mean Timer to Repair).
* Manage relationships and monitor agreements with external partners/vendors.
* Create policies or procedures for end-to-end supply chain activities.
* Plan and/or implement material flow management systems to meet production requirements.
* Analyze all aspects of corporate logistics to determine the most cost-effective, productive, accurate or timelines objectives of transporting product or supplies.
* Implement specific customer requirements, such as internal reporting or customized transportation metrics.
* Monitor product import/export processes to ensure compliance with regulatory or legal requirements.
* Negotiate transportation rates or services.
* Negotiate with suppliers or customers to improve supply chain efficiency or sustainability.
* Plan and implement improvements to internal or external logistics systems or processes.
* Recommend new or improved technology, such as automated systems.
* Develop risk management programs to ensure continuity of supply in emergency scenarios.
* Collaborate with other departments to integrate logistics with business systems or processes, such as sales, order management, accounting, customer support, product, NPI (New Product Introduction), and quality.
* Direct or coordinate comprehensive logistical or reverse logistical functions for product life cycles, including acquisition, distribution, internal allocation, delivery, recycling, reuse, or final disposal of resources.
* Conduct or review environmental audits for logistics activities, such as storage, distribution, or transportation.
* Lead a team of operations specialists to execute these responsibilities with your guidance.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* B.S. in Industrial engineering, Operations, Logistics or other related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 6 years’ experience in Hardware Operations & Supply chain and at least 4 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
* Excellent analytical skills, experience with self-service BI reporting.
* Understanding of statistics, operation research and optimization of transportation networks.
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
* Strong communication skills and effectively presents information to leaders, employees, and customers.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects.
* Driven, positive, and effective leader.
* Strong process orientation and developmental skills.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate a global operations organization.
* Successful completion of a background screening process including, but not limited to, employment verifications, criminal search, OFAC, SS Verification, as well as credit and drug screening, where applicable and in accordance with federal and local regulations.

#### **HR Operations Coordinator**

#### **About National Quality Systems**

National Quality Systems (NQS) is a healthcare SaaS company headquartered in Winter Park, Florida. NQS builds and supports clinical registry platforms serving trauma, burn, and emergency general surgery programs across the United States. Our platforms connect clinical outcomes with operational and financial performance data, helping healthcare organizations improve patient care and program performance. NQS is a remote-first company committed to building scalable systems, a high-performance culture, and a strong employee experience.

#### **Position Summary**

The HR Operations Coordinator supports HR operations, payroll processing, and general administrative functions across NQS. This role serves as a key operational resource for NQS executive leadership, ensuring HR processes, payroll activities, and company logistics are executed accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple functional areas in a fast-moving, remote environment. This is a fully remote position with occasional travel required.

Key Responsibilities

#### **HR Operations**

* Assist with drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and other HR documents for review and approval by executive leadership
* Support the onboarding process for new employees including coordination of background checks, Paychex Flex setup, I9 documentation, and prestart communications
* Maintain and organize employee files in SharePoint and NQS HR systems in compliance with recordkeeping requirements
* Support employee recognition activities and internal HR communications
* Assist with performance management administration including scheduling review cycles and tracking completion in Paychex Flex
* Support compliance activities including EVerify, employment eligibility documentation, and audit preparation
* Assist with HR policy documentation, SOPs, and internal process updates as directed

#### **Payroll and Tax Coordination**

* Process and administer payroll in Paychex Flex on a scheduled basis, ensuring accuracy of hours, deductions, and compensation data
* Support multistate payroll tax compliance by coordinating with the company's external accounting firm and legal support to ensure state tax registrations and nexus obligations are tracked and addressed
* Assist with new state registration processes as NQS expands its remote workforce footprint
* Identify and escalate payroll discrepancies or compliance concerns to executive leadership
* Maintain payroll records and support documentation for internal and external audits

#### **Administrative and Planning Support**

* Coordinate logistics for company inperson meetings and travel including RFP coordination for venues, hotel blocks, and travel arrangements
* Support calendar coordination for executive leadership as needed
* Assist with administrative tasks and special projects assigned by executive leadership
* Support preparation and organization of internal documents, presentations, and company communications
* Assist with vendor coordination and followup related to HR and operational service providers

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in HR operations, payroll administration, or a comparable administrative support role
* Demonstrated experience processing payroll in an HRIS or payroll platform
* Working knowledge of multistate payroll concepts and tax compliance fundamentals
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
* High attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation and data entry
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and SharePoint
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle confidential employee information with discretion and professionalism
* Legal authorization to work in the United States

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Paychex Flex or a comparable HRIS platform
* Familiarity with multistate employment compliance and state tax registration processes
* Prior experience supporting HR operations in a remote or distributed workforce environment
* Experience coordinating travel logistics or vendor RFP processes
* Exposure to healthcare or SaaS industry environments
* PHR, SHRMCP, or comparable HR certification is a plus

#### **Work Environment**

This is a fully remote position within the United States. Occasional travel for company meetings, in-person planning sessions, or other organizational events may be required.

#### **Compensation**

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000 to $85,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications. NQS offers a competitive benefits package including health insurance, paid time off, and additional benefits as outlined in the company's benefit plan documents.

Compliance, Legal, and Employment Statements

#### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

National Quality Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

#### **At-Will Employment**

Employment with National Quality Systems is at will. This job description is not a contract of employment. NQS may modify the duties, responsibilities, or requirements of this role at any time based on organizational needs and at its discretion.

Confidentiality and Data Security Requirements

This position may involve access to confidential and protected patient information. All employees must comply with HIPAA regulations and adhere to company policies, SOC 2 requirements, and industry standards related to data privacy, security, and proper handling of protected health information. Compliance with all NQS privacy and security protocols, including practices consistent with HITRUST frameworks, is mandatory.

#### **Reasonable Accommodation**

Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the application process, or employees who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their role, should contact the NQS Human Resources team.

#### **Pre-Employment Requirements**

Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of required background checks, verification of eligibility to work in the United States, and any additional pre-employment screenings as required by NQS.

#### **Other Duties**

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified at any time to reflect changing business needs. Additional duties may be assigned as required.

Point Broadband and Clearwave Fiber are affiliated companies operating as part of a combined organization. This opportunity is a Point Broadband position, and candidates selected for hire will be employed by Point Broadband under Point Broadband’s benefit plans, payroll, and employment policies.
  
  
Network Operations Specialist
  
Remote - Successful candidate must live in a state in which Point Broadband operates (AL, FL, GA, IL, KS, MD, MI, NY, OH, TN, TX, or VA) #LI-remote
  
  
**Summary:**  
This position is responsible for monitoring and maintaining Point Broadband's network infrastructure to ensure uninterrupted service for customers. This role includes real-time monitoring, troubleshooting, responding to incidents, collaborating with both internal and external teams, and proactively addressing potential issues to maintain operational excellence and deliver superior customer experiences.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**  
Essential duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to those listed below:
  
  

* Adhere fully to all policies and guidelines of Point Broadband and the Network Operations Center, including the Point Broadband Value System and NOC Core Values.
* Utilize Network Management System (NMS) tools and alarm notifications to oversee the network infrastructure, including routers, switches, circuits, and backbone connections.
* Respond promptly to alerts and incidents to minimize downtime. Create tickets to track all outages while adhering to the Incident Management Process.
* Identify and troubleshoot network performance issues, outages, and possible security threats. Escalate any outages to the correct fix agent(s) once identified and escalate critical issues to NOC leadership, engineers, or relevant departments as needed.
* Perform initial diagnostics of network-related issues and coordinate resolutions with engineering teams, field technicians, and customer support.
* Provide technical support and coordination for network maintenance, upgrades, and migrations.
* Maintain detailed documentation of incidents, actions taken, and resolutions within the internal ticketing system (tell the full story of each issue and resolution).
* Analyze network traffic patterns and performance metrics to proactively identify potential issues or areas for improvement.
* Assist in configuring, testing, and deploying new network hardware and software solutions.
* Support routine maintenance activities such as firmware updates, hardware replacements, system patches, or server reboots per department policies.
* Work closely with field technicians to support on-premises troubleshooting efforts.
* Assist in creating and maintaining department documentation such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and market-specific guides.
* Research updates for core documentation related to new markets, cabinets, circuits, or decommissioned equipment.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to carry out each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  
  
**Education & Experience:**  

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s degree or higher in IT, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field preferred.
* CCNA, CompTIA Network+, JNCIA, or equivalent certifications preferred.
* 2+ years in network operations, IT support, or telecommunications.
* Hands-on experience with fiber-to-the-premise (FTTP), fixed wireless networks, and enterprise network environments is a plus.

**Technical Skills:**  

* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, CLI-based troubleshooting tools, and network monitoring software.
* Experienced in incident management, using ticketing systems, and implementing service restoration processes.
* Knowledge of Layer 2/3 networking, BGP, OSPF, and SNMP-based monitoring tools.
* Familiar with network security best practices and effective troubleshooting methodologies.

**Soft Skills:**  

* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities to effectively engage with both technical and non-technical teams.
* Capability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Willingness to work nights, weekends, holidays, and be on-call as needed.

**Physical Demands/Working Conditions:**  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job the employee is:
  
  

* Required to talk, hear, and communicate effectively.
* Regularly required to answer phones, be on bridge calls or Zoom/Teams meetings, and take detailed notes during an investigation.
* Required to use hands to type, handle objects and paperwork.
* Required to reach and hold on to items at chest level or reach above the shoulder.
* Required to use close vision and be able to focus and to see colors.
* The employee generally works in an indoor office environment.
* Ability to work in a high-stress, high-demand environment is expected.

**Benefits:**

11b2a9dd49177ef5fbfe.title: Head of Client Success
11b2a9dd49177ef5fbfe.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

The Head of Client Success will drive enterprise retention through product adoption and drive long-term customer value creation the client portfolios. If you're ready to lead transformational client success initiatives and make a lasting impact on our business and our clients, we'd love to hear from you.

### **What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute customer success strategy aligned with company growth objectives, customer business outcomes, retention, and long-term customer value creation
* Own customer retention and supporting sales in revenue expansion across the customer portfolio, renewals, net revenue retention, cross-sell, upsell, and overall account growth
* Lead strategic account planning and governance in partnership with Sales, establishing account plans, executive engagement models, and processes to identify and capture growth opportunities
* Drive customer adoption and time-to-value by developing success plans that accelerate implementation, product utilization, business impact, and realization of customer ROI
* Establish customer health frameworks and performance metrics to measure adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, renewal risk, retention, expansion, and overall portfolio performance
* Use data, analytics, and experimentation to identify opportunities, evaluate program effectiveness, optimize customer engagement, and continuously improve customer success strategies
* Lead executive customer relationships by serving as a trusted advisor, executive sponsor, and escalation point for strategic accounts and complex customer challenges
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales and Product to align customer priorities with product strategy, commercial objectives, and service delivery
* Translate customer insights into business strategy by identifying emerging customer needs, market trends, adoption barriers, and opportunities for product innovation and go-to-market improvement
* Design scalable customer success operating models that balance high-touch strategic engagement with digital, programmatic, and self-service approaches to improve efficiency and customer lifetime value
* Establish operational rigor and accountability through standardized processes, success methodologies, portfolio reviews, forecasting, performance dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing organization by recruiting, coaching, retaining, and developing talent; establishing clear performance expectations; and building leadership succession
* Champion AI adoption and digital transformation across the customer success organization, identifying opportunities to automate administrative work, improve decision-making, and enable teams to focus on strategic customer engagement
* Communicate business performance and strategic priorities to executive leadership, presenting customer insights, retention and growth results, operational performance, risks, and recommendations
* Represent the company as a strategic partner and industry thought leader through executive engagements, customer forums, and external industry relationships

### **Requirements**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in client services, account management, customer success, or related client-facing leadership roles, with a track record of managing complex client relationships and driving business growth
* 7+ years of experience leading client services, account management, or customer-facing teams, including developing talent, scaling operations, and delivering measurable client and business outcomes
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise accounts and building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior stakeholders
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical technology, or other regulated industries
* Proven track record of driving customer adoption across the product portfolio
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including account growth strategy, revenue forecasting, customer lifetime value, and return on investment
* Experience building and implementing scalable Customer Success strategies, operating models, processes, and governance frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to use customer data, analytics, and performance metrics to assess customer health, identify risks, and drive business outcomes
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Marketing to achieve customer and company objectives
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, improve operational effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills
* Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing teams while establishing a culture of accountability and continuous learning
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

### **Nice to Have**

* Proven track record of driving customer retention, renewals, revenue expansion, and net revenue retention across enterprise customer portfolios
* Experience building and scaling digital, tech-touch, or programmatic Customer Success models that serve large customer populations efficiently
* Experience implementing AI-powered customer engagement, agentic workflows, and automation to improve customer outcomes and team productivity
* Experience designing customer lifecycle programs, including digital onboarding, adoption campaigns, lifecycle communications, and self-service experiences
* Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, leading indicators, and data-driven optimization of customer engagement programs
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud software, CRM, data platforms, or other technology-enabled business solutions
* Experience translating customer insights and market trends into product strategy, roadmap priorities, and go-to-market initiatives
* Experience developing customer health scoring, predictive retention models, adoption metrics, and portfolio performance dashboards
* Experience managing global or geographically distributed customer success teams and enterprise customer portfolios
* Experience establishing executive customer advisory programs, strategic partnerships, and industry thought leadership
* Master's degree in business, technology, or a related discipline

### **Interviewing with Veeva**

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:

  + A conversation with the hiring manager
  + A personality assessment
  + A practical case exercise
  + A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

### **Perks & Benefits**

* Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
* Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
* Retirement programs
* 1% charitable giving program

### **Compensation**

* Base pay: $200,000 - $270,000
* The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

###### **#LI-RemoteUS**

###### **#LI-MidSenior**

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent\_accommodations@veeva.com.

57246c0d12b1c371fa39.title: Director, Workforce Planning
57246c0d12b1c371fa39.description:
**About the team**
------------------

The Workforce Planning team sits at the center of Zillow’s customer-facing operations, helping ensure we have the right plans, tools, and insights in place to deliver a seamless experience for customers and sellers. We partner closely with leaders across operations, sales, finance, and technology to shape forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real-time performance strategies that support both business outcomes and a strong colleague experience. The team is organized into Command Center, Resource Planning, and Capacity Planning, each led by a dedicated leader. This team plays a key role in building scalable, data-informed frameworks that help Zillow grow thoughtfully while keeping our customers and employees at the heart of every decision.

**About the role**
------------------

The Director, Workforce Planning leads the strategy, planning, and execution of enterprise workforce management for Zillow’s customer-facing operations, ensuring the right people are in the right place at the right time to deliver an exceptional experience. This leader of leaders sets the vision for long-range capacity planning, forecasting, scheduling, and real-time performance management across contact center environments, using data-driven insights to optimize service levels, productivity, and colleague experience. The Director collaborates closely with senior business, operations, finance, and technology leaders to design scalable frameworks, challenge the status quo, and enable sustainable growth.

  

* Set the enterprise workforce management strategy for contact center operations, aligning capacity planning, staffing, and service level targets with Zillow’s business objectives and customer experience goals.
* Lead long-range and annual workforce planning, including demand forecasting, hiring plans, and budget inputs across sites, lines of business, and channels to support growth while managing cost and risk.
* Design and govern standardized WFM policies, frameworks, and KPIs (e.g., forecast accuracy, schedule adherence, occupancy, service levels) to ensure consistent practices and performance visibility across teams.
* Oversee the workforce management operating model and teams, including forecasting, scheduling, and real-time management functions, providing leadership, coaching, and development to team leaders and analysts.
* Partner with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, and vendor partners to align staffing strategies with volume trends, productivity goals, and workforce initiatives, enabling data-informed decisions on hiring, training, and deployment.
* Champion the roadmap for WFM tools and technology, including AI, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and vendor partners to implement and optimize workforce management systems, telephony routing, and reporting solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance forecast accuracy, schedule efficiency, shrinkage management, and intraday execution, using analytics and experimentation to test and scale best practices.
* Provide executive-level insights and recommendations through clear storytelling, dashboards, and operational reviews, highlighting risks, opportunities, and trade-offs in staffing and performance.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $142,500.00 - $227,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $135,400.00 - $216,200.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in workforce management, contact center operations, or a closely related field, including 5+ years in a people leadership role leading multi-function teams.
* Demonstrated experience owning enterprise or large-scale workforce planning, forecasting, and scheduling for high-volume, multi-channel environments (e.g., service or support), including BPO vendor partners.
* Proven success using data and analytics to diagnose performance drivers, improve forecast accuracy, and optimize staffing, productivity, and customer or sales outcomes.
* Track record of influencing senior leaders and cross-functional partners with clear, data-driven recommendations in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Working knowledge of WFM platforms such as Aspect, Genesys, or NICE, and related telephony or CRM tools.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. 89a5d6e0a21cfa065347.title: 401(k) Client Account Manager - WORK FROM HOME - US ONLY
89a5d6e0a21cfa065347.description:
**While this position is fully remote, we are only registered and can proceed with qualified candidates who reside and will work in one of the following states: AL, AZ, FL, GA, MI, MS, NE, NC, OH, OK, TN, TX. No exceptions. No relocation assistance is available.** **M****ust be eligible to work in the US without employment sponsorship.** **Direct Hire only, no third-party agency applications, please.**

**Job Description**

**Job Title:** Client Account Manager, Client Success

**Department:** Client Success **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Job Status:** FT

**Reports To: Manager, Clients Success** **Positions Supervised:** N/A

**Work Schedule:** Monday – Friday, Shift Varies between 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Client Account Manager (CAM), Client Success, is responsible for owning and managing the day‑to‑day client relationship for a designated book of retirement plan clients. Client books may include PEO MEPs, PEO PEPs, Advisor‑sponsored PEPs, and single‑employer plans, as well as the financial advisors associated with any of these arrangements.

Serving as the overall primary point of contact, the CAM is accountable for ensuring clear, consistent, and effective communication between clients, advisors, and Slavic401k. Information flowing into and out of the organization is generally coordinated through the CAM, who is responsible for maintaining alignment, setting expectations, and driving timely resolution of client needs.

The CAM delivers high‑quality, execution‑focused service while maintaining a strategic mindset centered on plan health, client satisfaction, and long‑term retention. While the role is predominantly tactical in nature, the CAM is expected to proactively communicate with clients and advisors, identify relationship risks, trends, or service gaps, and recommend or escalate actions as appropriate. In partnership with internal teams, the CAM supports positive client outcomes and a strong overall client experience.

Client book size and complexity will vary based on the size, structure, and needs of the plans and advisor relationships supported. Success in this role requires strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to balance transactional service delivery with proactive relationship management across a diverse client base. The CAM must be comfortable engaging with a variety of stakeholders and business representatives while independently managing priorities in a fast‑paced, client‑centric environment.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Own and manage the day‑to‑day client relationship for a designated book of retirement plan clients, which may include PEO MEPs, PEO PEPs, advisor‑sponsored PEPs, and single‑employer plans. Client book size and complexity will vary based on client needs, plan structure, and market segment.

* Serve as the **overall primary point of contact**, coordinating information flow between clients, advisors, and Slavic401k, and ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication across all interactions.

* Build and maintain strong client relationships with a focus on client satisfaction, trust, and retention, independently managing client expectations and ensuring a high‑quality service experience.

* Provide comprehensive administrative and client service support, leveraging a strong working knowledge of Slavic401k systems, tools, and resources for plan tracking, plan management, and service delivery.

* Maintain current knowledge of industry regulations, plan design considerations, and regulatory updates in order to effectively support clients and communicate relevant impacts to their plans.

* Act as the **end‑to‑end owner and coordinator of client issues and escalations****,** striving for first‑contact resolution when possible and partnering with internal teams and leadership as needed to drive timely and effective outcomes.

* Establish and maintain **regular client touchpoints** based on client needs and complexity, including service, planning, and administrative discussions related to plan changes, amendments, disclosures, and ongoing operational items.

* Proactively assess relationship health by identifying service gaps, relationship risks, trends, and retention indicators; track and report on relationship health metrics to support informed decision‑making and escalation when appropriate.

* Recommend proactive engagement, education, and support strategies, including collaboration with Strategic Consultants within the Strategic Services team, to improve plan health, client outcomes, and long‑term retention.

* Support Strategic Services initiatives by partnering on plan health efforts, engagement strategies, and outcome‑driven activities aligned with client and organizational goals.

* Develop and deliver customized reporting, client communications, and supporting materials based on client needs and service objectives.

* Conduct research on plan designs, ERISA requirements, and 401(k) rules to accurately communicate plan nuances, options, and constraints to clients.

* Facilitate client and prospective client demonstrations of all Slavic401k platforms and portals, as requested.

* Remain adaptable and responsive in a dynamic regulatory and operational environment, supporting ongoing changes related to compliance, plan enrollment, and plan administration.

* Contribute to departmental initiatives focused on operational efficiency, process improvement, cost reduction, plan growth, and client retention; may also serve as an owner of small initiatives or process improvements within Client Success.

* Accurately document client interactions, activities, and outcomes using Salesforce and other internal systems to support visibility, reporting, and continuity of service.

**SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to assess trends, risks, and relationship health indicators.

* Adaptability and keen attention to detail.

* Superior customer service skills with a focus on long-term client satisfaction and retention.

* Highly articulate with excellent interpersonal skills.

* Ability to build internal relationships and communicate effectively across teams and levels of the organization.

* Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in managing client relationships and expectations.

* Effective organizational skills and ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously.

* Ability to prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced, client-centric environment.

* Self-motivated, enthusiastic, and takes initiative.

* Strong written and oral communication skills.

* Proactive problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify issues, recommend solutions, and coordinate resolution

* Continuous improvement mindset aligned with organizational goals related to efficiencies, cost reductions, plan health, and client retention.

* Proficiency using Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

**Experience**

ec87c765dc56f56459bd.title: Talent Relations Specialist
ec87c765dc56f56459bd.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

At Basis, we empower agencies and brands with cutting-edge software that automates digital media operations. Our all-in-one platform supports seamless planning, reporting, and financial reconciliation across direct, programmatic, search, and social media.

We’re not just building advanced technology; we’re also building a culture where passionate, motivated individuals come together to drive meaningful change. Our commitment to inclusivity and growth ensures our employees thrive both professionally and personally.

With our headquarters in Chicago, we offer flexible work options across the U.S. and Canada, including remote, hybrid, or on-site at headquarters.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

Basis Technologies' Talent and Development (T&D) team works to make our organization an engaging, inclusive home for Beeps to develop their careers and create positive change in the ad tech industry. T&D is made up of four collaborative teams: Talent Acquisition (recruits top talent for Basis), Talent Operations (provides benefits, payroll, perks, and system support for Basis), Education and Development (leads training and education for Basis employees), and Talent Strategy (supports employee experience and engagement, business partnership, professional development, management resources, and employee relations).

Collectively, T&D is determined to bring the Basis Manifesto and guiding principles to life through our culture and practices. This team cultivates Raving Fans by constantly ideating on how to ensure every current and prospective employee receives the best experience possible.

* **While this role is remote, we have a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area who are able to occasionally attend and support onsite events at our Chicago office throughout the year.**

### **WAYS YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE**

This role reports to the Director, Employee Experience and Engagement and provides administrative, operational, and program support across both the Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner teams. You will help create the best employee experience possible for Beeps by keeping core programs and processes organized, responsive, and running smoothly; supporting culture and community efforts; and helping managers and employees navigate day-to-day questions and needs. You will contribute by:

* Providing administrative, coordination, and day-to-day execution support across the Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner teams, helping recurring priorities, requests, communications, documentation, and follow-ups move forward consistently.

* Serving as a first line of support for routine Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner requests, including monitoring Workday Help, supporting manager office hours, answering day-to-day questions, providing guidance on policies and people processes, triaging matters to the appropriate team member, tracking requests, and ensuring timely follow-through.

* Providing a trusted venue for employees to ask questions, share feedback, and express concerns, while escalating sensitive or complex matters when appropriate.

* Coordinating recurring employee lifecycle and people-process work, including voluntary offboarding, exit interviews, leave of absence documentation and follow-through, Workday transactions and tasks, Workday testing, and tracker maintenance, in partnership with the appropriate T&D teams.

* Supporting employee listening efforts, including employee check-ins and focus groups as needed, and helping identify and share themes that can inform the employee experience.

* Identifying themes from exit interviews, employee check-ins, listening efforts, and routine requests, and sharing regular insights with the Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner teams.

* Guiding employees and managers on growth opportunities for themselves and their teams, with a focus on enhancing performance and supporting employee engagement and retention.

* Providing execution and administrative support for key talent processes, including performance reviews, talent assessments, merit cycles, talent movement, retention efforts, communications, documentation, reporting, meeting coordination, scheduling, and general process administration.

* Supporting the execution and administration of employee experience and culture programs such as Basis Bravo, Basis Cares, recognition initiatives, mentorship programs, Workhuman administration, culture campaigns, and other recurring engagement efforts.

* Helping bring Basis culture and community to life through Basis Neighborhood Networks, HQ Week, employee appreciation efforts, events, resource creation, communications, and other activities that strengthen connection, recognition, and belonging across the organization.

* Partnering across T&D to brainstorm, plan, coordinate, communicate, execute, and sustain programs with a high level of quality and consistency.

* Jumping in on projects and miscellaneous team needs with curiosity, flexibility, and an eagerness to learn. We are looking for someone who is excited to help with anything and everything!

### **WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE**

* Trustworthiness and discretion with confidential and sensitive information.

* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and credibility with employees and managers.

* Strong judgment and the ability to recognize when a question or concern should be escalated.

* Ability to manage time across reactive requests, recurring responsibilities, and proactive priorities as they arise.

* Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and commitment to high-quality execution.

* Clear, thoughtful written and verbal communication skills.

* Solid work ethic and an unfaltering positive attitude.

* Ability to remain curious and focused even when the situation is ambiguous.

* Ability to work autonomously and at a fast pace; initiative and results focused.

* Proficiency using Microsoft Office and Outlook; comfort learning and working within HR systems and tools.

* Commitment to creating inclusive, respectful environments where all voices are valued and supported.

* Thoughtful approach to collaboration, program execution, and decision-making that prioritizes equity, access, and continuous learning.

### **BONUS POINTS**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred; associate degree in business, Human Resource Management, a related field, or equivalent education and experience.

* Professional in Human Resources (PHR) or SHRM certification preferred.

* Two or more years of experience in Human Resources, employee experience, employee relations, people program administration, program coordination, or a related field preferred.

* Previous experience with Workday, Workhuman, employee lifecycle processes, or people program administration preferred.

**Integrity in Hiring**

At Basis, integrity is at the core of how we hire. To protect our candidates and our company, we verify identity, education, and employment history for all hires. Some roles may also require onsite or in-person interviews as part of the process. Any misrepresentation of identity, experience, or skills may result in removal from the hiring process or termination of employment. We value transparency and authenticity and expect the same from every applicant.

**Anything Else?**

Don’t have every skill listed? No problem! We know experience can be built in many ways. If you have relevant skills that aren't reflected in your resume, we encourage you to share them in an optional cover letter.

  

**Life with Basis**

We’re committed to our people’s growth and well-being because our success is tied to theirs. That’s why we’ve earned recognition as a top workplace, including: Ad Age, #1 Best Places to Work 2025, WorkLife's #1 Most Committed to Work Life Balance, and the Chicago Tribune's Top Workplaces in Chicago. We offer competitive perks, including a flexible work week, 401k/RRSP matching, mental health support, paid sabbaticals, generous parental leave, flexible work options, and more.

Basis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate all team members regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, disability, age, and beyond.

If you need assistance with interview accessibility, please contact talent.acquisition@basis.com. Your privacy is important to us, view our policy here.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

9d616315800701aae2b6.description:
**Our Mission**
---------------

As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers.

(\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026)

**Day to Day**
--------------

At Indeed, we're on a mission to help people get jobs. As a Program Manager III within Legal, you will contribute to that mission by managing complex, cross-functional programs that strengthen Legal’s ability to navigate risk, support innovation, and advance business priorities. You will partner with Legal leaders and teams across Indeed to turn priorities into actionable plans with clear milestones and success measures. With minimal oversight, you will manage timelines, scope, and interdependencies, proactively anticipate challenges, and keep programs moving forward. You will bring clarity to complex initiatives through effective communication, transparent reporting, and thoughtful escalation of decisions requiring leadership attention. You'll also find opportunities to leverage AI and improve how programs are delivered, driving greater efficiency, consistency, and impact across Legal.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Orchestrate program planning and delivery across functions; align priorities, resources, and trade-offs to business strategy.
* Build consensus and secure buy-in autonomously; facilitate decision-making with data-backed options and implications.
* Identify, evaluate, and recommend systemic/process improvements; implement innovative, sustainable solutions.
* Establish risk, issue, and dependency management mechanisms; drive mitigations through closure with accountable owners and timelines.
* Ensure documentation quality (charters, plans, RACI, decision/risk logs) and accessibility across teams; uphold audit readiness.
* Integrate AI/automation opportunities into program work; measure impact on efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Deliver outcomes that advance business priorities; maintain alignment between strategy and execution across workstreams.

**Skills/Competencies**
-----------------------

* Requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience; or a minimum of 8 years with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience.
* Program Leadership: Multi-workstream orchestration, roadmap ownership, and cross-functional alignment.
* Influence & Communication: Independent buy-in, executive-ready reporting, and clear recommendation framing.
* Risk & Dependency Management: Proactive identification, interdependency assessment, and mitigation execution.
* Operational Excellence: High-quality documentation, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.
* AI-Enabled Delivery: Intentional integration of AI to scale programs and improve consistency.
* Strategic Execution: Aligns delivery to business target; anticipates opportunities and constraints across the portfolio.

Tier 1 - United States of America 96,000 - 144,000 USD per year  
Tier 2 - United States of America 107,000 - 161,000 USD per year

Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process. The range(s) listed is just one component of Indeed's total compensation package for employees. -----------------------------------------------------

We care about what you care about. We have a multitude of benefits to support Indeedians, as well as their pets, kids, and partners including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance. Indeedians are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, as well as an equity-based incentive program. Indeedians will also receive open paid time off, 11 paid holidays a year and up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave. For more information, select your country and learn more about our employee benefits, program, & perks at https://www.indeed.com/careers/benefits!

----------------------------------------------------

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, family status, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, neuro-diversity, disability, age, or veteran status, or any other non-merit based or legally protected grounds.

Inclusion and belonging are fundamental to our hiring practices and company culture, forming an integral part of our vision for a better world of work. ff976a9d839d35fda250.title: Senior Clinical Review Operations Pharmacist
ff976a9d839d35fda250.description:
**Who We Are:**

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

* **Integrity:** Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
* **Courage:** We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
* **Together:** The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

**Job Summary:**

  

SmithRx is looking for a motivated Senior Clinical Review Operations Pharmacist to serve as a clinical subject matter expert and key operational driver within our Prior Authorization team. This individual contributor role is pivotal in maintaining high-quality clinical reviews, ensuring adherence to turnaround times, and delivering exceptional member experiences. Your primary focus will be building tools to support prior authorization evaluations, driving process improvements, mentoring peer pharmacists on clinical protocols, and serving as a key cross-functional innovator to scale our clinical operations.

**What you will do:**

* **Process & Technology Optimization:** Identify operational process gaps and champion technology-driven solutions to improve throughput, scalability, and workflow efficiency.
* **Clinical Mentorship & Quality Assurance:** Serve as a clinical peer lead, providing guidance, coaching, and onboarding support to fellow pharmacists to foster clinical consistency and quality.
* **Complex Escalations:** Act as a senior operational contact for complex clinical cases, escalated coverage determinations, and appeals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with internal teams to troubleshoot eligibility questions, claims adjudication, and benefit design nuances.
* **Clinical Policy & P&T Committee Support:** Collaborate with clinical leadership and the Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) Committee to help develop, refine, and review clinical criteria for medications requiring prior authorization.
* **Performance & SLAs:** Consistently meet or exceed individual target KPIs and turn-around-time (TAT) SLAs to maintain seamless operating standards.
* **Change Champion:** Drive adoption of new technology, workflow tools, and updated clinical protocols across the Clinical Review team.

**What you will bring to SmithRx:**

* 5+ years of health plan or Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) experience, specifically involved in prior authorization review and clinical operations.
* Demonstrated expertise as a clinical subject matter expert with a track record of driving process improvements or technology-driven efficiencies.
* Active Pharmacist License (unrestricted) required.
* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) required.
* Strong proficiency with Mac, MS Office, and G-Suite platforms.
* High degree of empathy with excellent active listening and communication skills to clearly convey complex clinical information to members, providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Proven self-starter with superior multitasking, time management, and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of drug product/dose calculations, claim adjudication rules, and general pharmacy dispensing processes.
* Adaptability to evolving clinical guidelines, changing protocols, and new operational technology.

**What SmithRx Offers You:**

* Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
* Flexible Spending Benefits
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Program
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Discretionary Paid Time Off
* Paid Company Holidays
* Wellness Benefits
* Commuter Benefits
* Paid Parental Leave benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Well-stocked kitchen in office locations
* Professional development and training opportunities

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary:** The range listed above reflects our standard pay scale and actual pay will vary based on work location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
* **Total Rewards:** In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. SmithRx offers a variety of benefits to help you live well, including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance and 401(k).

Individual offers are tailored to your geography, experience, skills, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details during the hiring process. In the meantime, feel free to explore our comprehensive benefits here.

327c19f0083f98496a8a.title: Project Coordinator - Power Delivery
327c19f0083f98496a8a.description:
WSP is currently initiating a search for a Power Delivery Project Management Project Coordinator.

Be involved in projects with our Project Management Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

This position should be based out of Denver CO, Boise ID, Salt Lake City UT, Billings MT, or remotely from any mutually acceptable location in this region.

**This Opportunity**
--------------------

Provides advanced administrative and logistical support to project teams by coordinating activities that promote operational efficiency, documentation integrity, and cross-functional collaboration. Oversees complex assignments requiring the ability to interpret project plans, manage information workflows, and ensure timely execution of critical tasks. Works independently with minimal supervision to resolve issues, implement process improvements, and contribute to successful project delivery. Serves as a key liaison between project managers, internal departments, and external stakeholders to facilitate seamless project coordination and reporting.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* Develop and maintain detailed project logs, schedules, and status reports for use by internal teams and clients.
* Coordinate the creation, formatting, and finalization of client deliverables, ensuring consistency and adherence to established standards.
* Lead the administration and distribution of critical documentation including contracts, submittals, RFIs, and project change orders.
* Track project milestones and proactively follow up with team members to ensure completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Manage internal documentation systems and repositories, applying version control and audit protocols.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project-related inquiries, supporting internal and external communication flows.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Finance teams to monitor project budgets, coordinate invoice approvals, and ensure timely payments.
* Assist with data entry and verification for cost reports, timesheets, and vendor submissions.
* Facilitate project meetings by preparing agendas, recording notes, tracking action items, and distributing follow-up materials.
* Support onboarding of project staff by coordinating required access, credentials, and documentation.
* Assist in the resolution of administrative and logistical challenges by identifying root causes and recommending improvements.
* Coordinate updates to project dashboards and reporting tools, including cross-checking input from multiple contributors.
* Provide support in audit and compliance reviews by compiling required documentation and maintaining detailed records.
* Ensure documentation related to safety plans, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements are maintained and distributed appropriately.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of templates, procedures, and project coordination workflows.
* Monitor the use of shared project resources such as drives, software platforms, and communication tools to ensure team-wide alignment.
* Lead or co-lead administrative segments of large projects or task orders requiring coordination between multiple offices.
* Serve as a resource and provide guidance to more junior staff on project coordination practices.
* Anticipate risks related to schedule, documentation, or compliance, and escalate appropriately with recommendations.
* Track deliverable production cycles and assist in developing timelines and quality check protocols.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant post-education experience in related job capacity.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycles, including planning, execution, and close-out phases.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project tracking tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, or Excel-based trackers.
* Experience with documentation management platforms such as SharePoint, Procore, or similar systems.
* Knowledge of administrative controls related to contracts, invoicing, and procurement activities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining data accuracy and integrity.
* Ability to interpret and implement project coordination policies, procedures, and standards.
* Professional communication skills for drafting correspondence, managing inquiries, and presenting project updates.
* Experience compiling data and generating reports tailored to diverse audiences and stakeholders.
* Capacity to identify process inefficiencies and suggest or implement enhancements.
* Comfort navigating cross-functional relationships between technical, administrative, and financial teams.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve non-standard challenges using sound judgment.
* Skilled in time management and able to monitor and coordinate across multiple task owners and deadlines.
* Ability to work independently with minimal direction and to prioritize tasks based on changing project needs.
* Experience managing documentation associated with subconsultants, contracts, and permits.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive materials appropriately.
* Track record of contributing to successful team coordination on medium to large-scale projects.
* Ability to lead documentation audits or coordinate data gathering during internal or external reviews.
* Willingness to support the development of junior staff in coordination-related tasks.
* Demonstrated reliability, initiative, and accountability in supporting project teams.
* Ability to meet attendance schedule with dependability and consistency.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate's Degree.
* Experience supporting multi-office or multidisciplinary project teams.
* Exposure to AEC project documentation standards, including QA/QC practices.
* Professional training or coursework in project coordination, document control, or construction administration.

1c31649932f571382eb4.description:
**Regional Director of Operations-Remote (Central PA)**

Employment Type: Full Time

EEOC Classification: Exempt

Reports to: **Sr. Regional Director of Operations**

**At Community Veterinary Partners (CVP), we believe pets bring kindness and compassion to the world, which is why we're dedicated to creating meaningful moments with pets and people.**

**As an integrated community of more than 3600 Team Members and 140+ hospitals, our team is passionate about caring for pets, their families, and one another. We provide resources and mentorship to support growth and drive innovation in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment. At CVP, you'll find a community that fosters connection and collaboration, all while nurturing those special moments that strengthen the bond between pets and people.**

**SUMMARY**

The Regional Director of Operations is a strategic member of the Community Veterinary Partners’ leadership team. This position is responsible for providing tactical direction and vision to the CVP family of veterinary hospitals. The Regional Director of Operations will be responsible for 13 to 17 locations.

Community Veterinary Partners manages Veterinary Hospitals within the eastern United States. Our hospitals have roots in their local communities with a legacy of strong relationships our clients and their pets

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

**Quality of Care**

* Ensure each hospital provides a high level of customer service to our clients and pets
* Ensure all CVP medical and non-medical standards are upheld; works with the Medical and Operational Advisory Boards to improve upon those falling short.
* Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures with all local, state and federal laws.
* Ensure the safety of pets, clients and team members and the maintenance of clean, safe and organized hospitals

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensures successful assimilation of new partner hospitals into the CVP family
* Develop and maintain strong business relationships with Practice Managers, Lead Doctors and Associate Doctors
* Work with Practice Managers and Lead Doctors to improve operational outcomes; including revenue growth and control of inventory, purchasing, labor and other expenses
* Accountable for P&L management; provides monthly reporting to Core Leadership team on outcomes, responsible for development of remediation strategies
* Initiate and actively supervise facility improvement projects to provide a professional physical plant that exceeds customer and regulatory expectations

**Growth**

* Review hospital performance/results of key financial metrics such as revenue, growth, labor, purchasing, and capital expenditures
* Achieve profitable growth objectives within assigned region
* Partner with Practice Managers and Lead Doctors to develop solutions for revenue and cost control challenges and opportunities
* Development of fiscal, strategic and clinical processes in partnership with the hospitals.
* Develop, communicate and implement proactive marketing strategies at each hospital for revenue growth in partnership with the Marketing team
* Assist the Business Development team in Identifying opportunities and strategies to acquire additional hospitals

**People & Culture**

* Work with Practice Managers and Lead Doctors to develop their leadership skills including fostering a culture of engagement and accountability
* Develop successful Practice Managers to continually surpass benchmarks
* Ensures each hospital provides a supportive, positive work environment for the team
* Work with hospital leadership to forecast staffing needs and initiate recruitment.
* Partners with Talent Acquisition to recruit and select Doctors and Practice Managers to meet the needs of the business
* Work with Human Resources to select, recruit, develop and mentor teams to realize their full professional potential and deliver outstanding high quality medical care, client service and business results
* Serves as escalation point for employee relation issues; partners with the Practice Manager to find amicable resolutions
* Partner with the Practice Managers to maintain appropriate scheduling and Doctor coverage. Approves time off for continuing education, PTO, etc. to support the needs of the team members and the hospital
* Performs other duties as assigned

Competencies

* Leadership
* Decisiveness
* High Emotional Intelligence
* Analytical Skills
* Coaching/Mentoring
* Change Management
* Communication Skills
* Financial Acumen
* Time Management

**SKILLS**

MS Office and Prior knowledge of Veterinary Practice Management Software is preferred.

**PREFERRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management or a related field is required or an equivalent combination of years education, training and years of experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

A minimum of Eight (8) years of Veterinary Practice/Management experience, preferably with three (3) years or more in multi-location management in a service industry role.

Reside in the Central PA area.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Responsible to manage and develop the skills of the assigned Practice Managers within assigned region.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

This is a high-travel (primarily by car) position.

**While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus.**
