7f24077f7037b5f3010b.description:
Overview:

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities:

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Enterprise IT Service Desk (EITSD) Support subtask, supporting the Digital Innovation for General Services Administration (GSA) Infrastructure Technologies (DIGIT) task order, is relied upon to provide IT services that appropriately respond to the time-sensitive needs of customers, including Very Important Persons (VIPs) and executives, and provide prompt referrals and escalations to an appropriate IT support service option. The EITSD provides support to users of GSA’s internal infrastructure as well as applications and systems owned by various GSA Service and Staff Offices. The EITSD is the centralized POC for GSA end users and customers to report incidents, submit requests, seek advice, and register complaints about GSA’s IT infrastructure, applications, and programs supported in the environment.

As a Subject Matter Expert Computer User Support Specialist, your primary responsibility is ticket processing and resolution management, which includes detailed and clear documentation of the problems and the actions taken to resolve them. Customer service is key to this position. You will provide technical assistance to computer users by answering questions to resolve computer problems for the end user. Typical assistance concerns the use of computer hardware and software, to include printing, installation, word processing, electronic mail, and operating systems.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages Deskside Support Technicians in the GSA R03 Regional Office Building.
* Performs a variety of clerical and administrative duties pertinent to onsite support.
* Responds to trouble tickets to resolve user problems; opens trouble tickets to track and resolve user problems.
* Provides technical support onsite or through phone, email, and instant message remotely to users in the areas of password resets, e-mail, directories, standard MS Windows desktop applications, MacBook support, smartphones and network connectivity.
* Provides computer or MacBook support problem analysis, and hardware/software installation and configuration.
* Interacts daily with customers to ensure productivity; provides individual feedback.
* Monitors team productivity and quality; provides individual feedback.
* Coordinate fix actions with other teams, document fix actions and train junior technicians in R03.
* Maintains an audit trail and statistical records of all problems and conditions reported by the client.
* Supports R03 Field Office visits personally or with R03 staff.

Qualifications:

**CONTRACT REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Public Trust Clearance (Or ability to obtain)
* ITILv4 Foundation Training and ITILv4 Foundation Certification may be obtained within 120 days

* Possesses and applies fundamental concepts, processes, practices, and procedures on work assignments.
* Provides technical/management leadership on major tasks or technology assignments.

* Has domain and expert technical knowledge.
* Decision-making and domain knowledge may have a critical impact on overall project implementation.
* Contributes to deliverables and performance metrics and may supervise others.

**CONTRACT DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must be willing to work a variety of shifts, including holidays as scheduled
* Possess the ability to communicate in both oral and written forms, demonstrating an ability to communicate effectively with all levels of staff as well as clients.
* Familiarity with the following technologies: **macOS,Windows, web browsers, and basic functions of Active Directory**

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Associates Degree
* 7-12 years of work experience.
* At least one (1) year experience with Windows desktop support.
* At least one (1) year of recent experience with macOS support.
* At least two (2) years experience working knowledge of remote tools.
* At least two (2) years of experience managing employees.
* Experience supporting industry standard software products.
* Experience as a remote worker demonstrating time management and self discipline.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to do the following:

  + Communicate verbally and respond to verbal communications in person, over the phone or by video chat.
  + Communicate clearly and succinctly in writing, primarily utilizing a keyboard.
  + Sitting for long periods.
  + Viewing computer screens for long periods of time.

About Empower AI:

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. 956b3ce045ecfe319478.title: Surgical Coordinator
956b3ce045ecfe319478.description:
Overview:

**Position Title:** Patient Services Representative  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Hours:** 7:30am-5pm (Monday-Friday)  
**Practice:** Millenium Eye Care, a PRISM Vision Group Partner Practice  
**Location:** Freehold, New Jersey

**Travel:** Required between offices dependent on office/location needs  
**Compensation:** $18.00 - $35.80 per hour, based on experience and qualifications

The Surgical Coordinator is the primary interface between practice surgery patients, surgeons and surgical
  
facilities. The Surgical Coordinator is responsible for scheduling pre-operative appointments and testing
  
and ophthalmic surgeries for the practice. As the primary liaison between the patient, surgeon and facility,
  
the Coordinator must have a good understanding and detailed knowledge of facility and procedure pre-op
  
testing requirements, ophthalmic practice and insurance coverages and reliably handle all associated
  
details relating to surgery patients. The Surgery Coordinator is the primary communications point for
  
surgery patients, providers and facilities.

Responsibilities:

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Contacts facilities for scheduling of surgery and arranges for pre-op testing.
* Organizes patient chart and collect all pertinent information for upcoming surgery.
* Schedules pre-op visits as needed with PCP, labs etc. and notes in electronic records and

scheduling systems.
  

* Calls for necessary pre-authorizations, for both surgery and medications.
* Orders tissue from tissue bank for corneal transplants and coordinate acceptance of tissue with

physician.
  

* Obtains preauthorization of surgical procedures as required by insurance companies and payers.
* Obtains preauthorization of medication and anesthesia orders as required by insurance companies

and payers.
  

* Coordinates paperwork and electronic records, including maintaining patient charts and chart

pulling for surgery review for surgeon.
  

* Maintains patient confidentiality.
* Consistently schedules surgery days to the mutual satisfaction of the patient, the surgeon and the

facility staff.
  

* Communicates to the patients in a manner that instills understanding and confidence about their

upcoming procedure.
  

* Follow-up telephone call to patient after surgery and document in the medical record.
* Handles all telephone communications with patient, patient’s family or primary physician regarding

surgery and pre-op visits.
  

* Reports any problems or unusual circumstances to the clinical manager or doctor.
* Performs IOL calculations and orders appropriate lenses at direction of physician for surgery.
* Understands characteristics of common anterior segment disorders.
* Understands, communicates and counsels patients regarding cataract surgery, lens implants, YAG

lasers, corneal procedures and facial and eyelid surgery and procedures.
  

* Understands and follows procedures for surgical and procedural consents.
* Comply with company compliance policies and standards

Qualifications:

**Education:** High School Graduate or General Education Degree (GED). Bachelor’s degree in relevant
  
discipline highly preferred.

**Certificates & Licenses**
  
None required

**Experience:** 4+ years of experience in a healthcare setting required.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

Working knowledge of ophthalmic testing including but not limited to biometry, EKG's, OCTs,
  
photos and visual field testing.
  

* Excellent verbal and written communications skills in English. Bi-Lingual (English/Spanish,

English/Polish, English/French, English/Arabic) a plus.
  

* Must possess excellent, critical thinking, analytical, troubleshooting, problem resolution, and

customer service skills.
  

* Excellent mathematical and cash management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with physicians, co-workers, other

departments and patients of all ages, and from across a broad range of cultural and social economic
  
backgrounds.
  

* Demonstrated accuracy, thoroughness and detail orientation
* Knowledge of medical terminology preferred.
* Ability to work as an integral team member under minimal supervision, in a fast-paced, complex

and highly stressful environment.
  

* Computer literate and ability to use multiple systems and acquire proficiency in multiple electronic

systems

**Computer Skills**

* Facile with Microsoft Products
* Within 4 weeks of hire must be facile with Athena PMS and practice based EMR

This is a full-time, non-exempt (hourly) position.

No travel is required

b6e99a044dd789ed13ba.description:
Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Our mission is to securely connect people, places, and information with end-to-end technology solutions at scale.

At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Work alongside industry-certified experts, access continuous training, and enjoy competitive benefits. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together

  

**New Era Technology offers:**

* *Full Benefits*
* *Medical*
* *Dental*
* *Vision*
* *401(k) match*
* *Flexible Time Off (FTO)*

  

**SUMMARY:**

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful execution and operational delivery of projects and programs assigned to them. This role provides leadership and oversight for a team of Technical Coordination Managers, Coordination Managers, Project Coordinators, and Service Coordinators to ensure consistent execution of project/program processes, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and delivery quality across a portfolio of projects and programs.

The Service Delivery Manager serves as the primary leadership point of contact for assigned customers, internal stakeholders, and delivery teams. The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, managing escalations, supporting resource planning, developing team capabilities, and ensuring projects are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and organizational standards.

  

**PRIMARY DUTIES:**

*Include, but are not limited to:*

* Lead and manage a team responsible for project and/or program delivery.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, performance management, and professional development opportunities for assigned team members.
* Maintain accountability for project delivery performance, customer satisfaction, schedule adherence, and financial outcomes across the assigned portfolio.
* Drive consistency in project execution, documentation, communications, and reporting standards.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, vendors, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Monitor portfolio health through review of project schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets, and resource utilization.
* Support forecasting, workload balancing, and resource planning activities across the program.
* Identify and mitigate delivery risks while ensuring timely escalation of critical issues.
* Ensure compliance with established project governance, quality standards, contractual requirements, and company policies.
* Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Review project metrics and key performance indicators to identify trends, opportunities, and corrective actions.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, lessons learned activities, and operational best practices.
* Collaborate with leadership on strategic planning, staffing requirements, and program expansion initiatives.
* Assist with onboarding, training, and development of new employees.

  

**COMPETENCIES & KEY SKILLS**

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Advanced stakeholder and customer relationship management capabilities.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong organizational and portfolio management abilities.
* Ability to effectively prioritize work across multiple projects, programs, and resources.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Financial management, budgeting, and forecasting experience.
* Risk management and escalation management expertise.
* Ability to lead through change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* High attention to detail with strong quality management focus.
* Working knowledge of structured cabling, networking, physical security, and technology deployment projects preferred.

  

**REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing projects, programs, or service delivery operations.
* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing project delivery personnel.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise customer programs.
* Experience managing project financials, forecasting, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and project management tools

  

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:** English

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment, including repetitive motions such as typing, scrolling, and mouse use. Ability to communicate effectively and understand verbal communication in person, by telephone, and through video conferencing or other remote communication tools. Ability to view and read information on computer screens and printed materials, including the ability to adjust focus. The position requires prolonged periods of computer use and viewing a computer screen.

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

  

**EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK:** Full-time, 40 hours per week. Additional hours may be required during peak project periods or critical customer initiatives.

  

**TRAVEL:** Travel expectations up to 20%.

  

*ADA Statement*

*An individual must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. The requirements outlined in this job description are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, and other qualifications necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. db5a1121eb255ec0b5e6.title: Scheduling Coordinator
db5a1121eb255ec0b5e6.description:
Overview:

CentraState Healthcare System, headquartered in Freehold, New Jersey, is a leading nonprofit healthcare provider dedicated to serving the community. Its comprehensive network includes CentraState Medical Center, a community-focused hospital, along with an ambulatory campus, two senior living facilities, three free-standing community health pavilions, and a charitable foundation. As the third-largest employer in Monmouth County, CentraState has earned repeated recognition as a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company, reinforcing its reputation as an exceptional workplace.

CentraState Medical Center is currently seeking a **Scheduling Coordinator** to support its Physical Therapy department. This role involves registering and scheduling patients in accordance with established procedures, pre-screening patients to determine accurate financial responsibilities, securing all legal consents and insurance information, assigning patient rooms based on established criteria, verifying insurance coverage, coordinating with Outcomes Managers, and obtaining pre-certification authorization as appropriate.

Responsibilities:

* Accurately registers each account following all departmental procedures to ensure compliance with State and Federal regulations.
* Obtains and determines the coordination of benefits and accurately inputs into the computer software system following industry standards and departmental procedure.
* Clearly documents all communication with patients, family members and physicians. Documents any exceptions to standard procedure.
* Follows federal and state standards and complies with all regulations including accurate completion the MSP form and DOBI consent.
* Accurately utilizes Imaging system by scanning all paperwork into correct document and folder during registration, scheduling and verification process.
* Completes quality checks and reviews each registration for correct information. Seeks assistance and plans corrective action.
* Handles departmental paperwork flow in a manner consistent with departmental policies and procedures.
* Takes the initiative in contacting patients that have been scheduled by ancillary departments to obtain accurate pre registration information.
* Files all charts and paperwork in appropriate areas as time permits.
* Makes complete and appropriate notations on appointments not scheduled/pre-registered by patients and places all information on such in appropriate pre-registration folder for later follow-up.
* Answers all calls in a professional and courteous manner, taking any action necessary to ensure the callers needs have been met.
* Accurately schedules patient appointments for ancillary services. Obtains all information required by the various departments and enters into the scheduling system.
* Communicates with patients clearly and professionally to accurately provide preps for all tests, making sure instructions are understood by patient, as well as documenting providing directions and insurance guidelines. Documents communication with patients as needed.
* Clearly documents in computer system all communication with patients and/or family members.
* Readily communicates with ancillary departments to ensure accuracy in appointments scheduled. Calls departments directly with questions regarding specific tests, preps or last minute cancellations.
* Documents communication with departments in appropriate patient charts.
* Maintains productivity within guidelines set by department.

Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Hospital experience in registration preferred.
* Hospital experience in billing preferred.
* Knowledge of medical terminology.
* Strong customer service skills.

About Us:

CentraState Healthcare System, in partnership with Atlantic Health System, is a fully accredited, not-for-profit, community-based health system dedicated to providing comprehensive health services in central New Jersey. Beyond offering a wide range of advanced diagnostic and treatment options, CentraState is committed to being a valuable health partner, focusing on disease prevention, promoting healthy behaviors, and helping individuals of all ages live well.

Located in Freehold, CentraState includes a 284-bed acute-care hospital, a dynamic health and wellness campus, two award-winning senior living communities, a charitable foundation, and convenient satellite health pavilions. These pavilions offer primary care, specialty physician practices, and access to outpatient services such as lab work and physical therapy.

CentraState is proud to be among the less than two percent of hospitals nationwide to earn Magnet® designation for nursing excellence five times. Additionally, it has been recognized as a Great Place to Work-Certified™ Company by Great Place to Work® for four consecutive years.

Joining CentraState means becoming part of a pioneering healthcare facility committed to high-quality, patient-focused care. We invite you to make a difference in our community and advance your career with us. We support our employees with work/life balance initiatives, tuition assistance, career advancement opportunities, and more.

Discover why our employees love their jobs and being part of the CentraState family!

CentraState Health System offers a competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports the health, financial security, and well-being of all team members.

What We Offer:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Coverage (30 hours per week or above for full-time and part-time team members)
* Life & AD&D Insurance
* Long-Term Disability (with options to supplement)
* 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer match
* 401(a) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
* PTO
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Well-Being Rewards
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Fertility Coverage, Healthy Pregnancy Program
* Flexible Spending & Commuter Accounts
* Pet, Home & Auto, Identity Theft and Legal Insurance
* Growth Opportunity and Workforce Development Initiatives
* Continuing Education / Onsite Training
* A warm, welcoming company culture based upon mutual respect and a collaborative goal of providing excellent patient care
* Concierge Services with Work & Family Benefits
* Magnet recognized healthcare facility

Compensation Range: $18.00 - $28.80 per hour

The compensation above reflects the established range from CentraState Healthcare System (CSHS) for this position at the time the job was posted. a1f301468048be0419be.title: District Support Pharmacist Full Time
a1f301468048be0419be.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Job Purpose and Summary:**

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our District Support Pharmacists (DSPs) play a critical role in cultivating a culture of excellence within each pharmacy worked by acting as a role model for all, demonstrating genuine care, and setting the bar for the pharmacy team.

As a DSP, you have a critical role at the forefront of delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. You will work within the district to cover pharmacist scheduling gaps, under the direction of the Pharmacy Manager (PM) and Rx District Leader (DL) to support our pharmacy teams. While working in stores throughout the district, you are accountable for supporting the management, oversight, and operation of the pharmacy and pharmacy team.

The DSP’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Living our purpose by helping to manage and improve patient health through safe and appropriate dispensing, counseling, and immunizing practices
* Traveling the district to fill pharmacist shifts as scheduled by the District Performance Coordinator (DPC); overseeing the pharmacy and serving as the Pharmacy Manager’s proxy during bench shifts without overlap
* Supporting safe and accurate prescription fulfillment by following—and directing the pharmacy team to follow—pharmacy workflow procedures and utilizing the safety guardrails at every workstation
* Assumes Pharmacy Manager’s day-to-day duties when serving as the only or the primary pharmacist-on-duty
* Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care and coaching the pharmacy team to do the same: demonstrating compassionate care, collaborating with the patient’s total healthcare team, and proactively resolving insurance and/or medication issues
* Proactively offering and delivering immunizations to keep patients healthy; engaging and supporting Pharmacy Technicians to learn to immunize
* Supporting the effective management of pharmacy inventory in all pharmacies worked by following—and guiding the pharmacy team to follow—all inventory best practices, with a special focus on protecting cold chain products for our patients and our business
* Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic
* Maintaining relevant clinical and technical skills for the job as the industry evolves (including but not limited to company-required trainings and CMEs); actively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge to better support patients
* Supporting access to care and helping to improve patient outcomes through pharmacist delivered clinical care such as testing and prescribing services (e.g., COVID/Flu, Hormonal Contraception, etc.) where permissible; empowers the pharmacy team to provide holistic care at every step in the patient care journey
* Understanding and complying with all relevant federal and state laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles; complying with CVS Health policies and procedures to help support patient safety and complying with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, to protect patient privacy and security, and to maintain a safe and inclusive workplace for our colleagues

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Pharmacist License in the state where the Store is located
* Active National Provider Identifier (NPI)
* Not on the DEA Excluded Parties list

**Essential Functions:**

* Ability to travel within a reasonable radius to support market staffing as business needs require
* Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
* Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
* Attention and Focus:
  + Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
  + Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
  + Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
* Customer Service and Team Orientation:
  + Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
  + Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
* Communication Skills:
  + Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
  + Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
* Mathematical Reasoning:
  + Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
* Problem Resolution:
  + Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
* Physical Demands:
  + Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
  + Lift, scan, and bag items
  + Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
  + Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
  + Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
  + Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
  + Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
  + Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
  + Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
  + Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
  + Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
* Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1-2 years of related work experience in a pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting

Our diverse work experience empowers colleagues for career success. In addition to skill and experience, we attract and retain colleagues whose beliefs and behaviors are in alignment with our core values of collaboration, innovation, caring, integrity, and accountability.

CVS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We value and are committed to the full spectrum of diversity in the workplace, including diversity based on gender, race, ethnicity, disability and protected Veteran status. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists, and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. We comply with the laws and regulations set forth in the following EEO is the Law Poster: EEO IS THE LAW and EEO IS THE LAW SUPPLEMENT. We provide reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance to apply for or perform this job, please contact Colleague Relations team at colleaguerelations@cvshealth.com.

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$60.00 - $76.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

8e3900b92dd2a50e0b8b.title: Property Management Coordinator I
8e3900b92dd2a50e0b8b.description:
TYPICAL EXAMPLES OF WORK (ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY)

**Property Management**

* Conducts inspections and photographs of vacant land and sidewalks for which PRA, PLB, and PHDC have ongoing property management responsibility in response to the City of Philadelphia’s Department of Licenses & Inspections (L&I) and Community Life Improvement Program (CLIP) violations, reports of unauthorized occupancy, nuisance complaints, insurance claims, and other property management matters.
* Posts Cease and Desist notices, Orders to Vacate, and other authorized notices for land and properties maintained by the agencies.
* Documents property conditions and prepares clear and accurate inspection findings and photographic records.
* Identifies property maintenance and remediation needs and prepares estimates of necessary repairs and replacements within the scope of assigned responsibilities.
Engages landscaping subcontractors and the PHDC maintenance team to remediate violations.  

**Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Contract Administration**

* Inspects and photographs vacant land in preparation for the issuance of RFPs for property management services.
* Assists in the preparation of RFPs regarding the intent to solicit and engage third-party firms to provide services.
* Posts RFPs and related materials in accordance with established procedures.
* Monitors and inspects work performed by approved subcontractors to determine whether established contractual milestones have been achieved.
* Inspects completed subcontractor work and documents conformity with applicable requirements of the executed agreement.

**Accounting and Recordkeeping**

* Project cost allocation - identifies, accumulates, and assigns shared or indirect costs (like rent, utilities, or administrative salaries) to specific projects and work orders.
* Payroll cost allocation - distributes Maintenance employees’ total time across different departmental cost centers and projects.
Invoice review - examines vendor bills before payment to verify accuracy, compliance, and legitimate charges to departmental cost centers and projects.  

Performs other related duties as required.

  

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Knowledge of basic principles and practices related to property management, property maintenance, contract administration, and work order coordination.
* Knowledge of basic methods and practices used to identify property maintenance needs and estimate necessary repairs and replacements.
* Knowledge of basic accounting and recordkeeping principles and procedures applicable to project cost allocation, payroll cost allocation, invoice review, and maintenance of supporting documentation
* Knowledge of basic principles and procedures related to RFPs and the administration and monitoring of service contracts.
* Skill in performing basic mathematical calculations accurately and analyzing numerical information related to project costs, payroll allocations, invoices, and work orders.
* Skill in preparing and maintaining clear, accurate, and complete written inspection findings, reports, correspondence, and other documentation.
* Skill in documenting property conditions through photographs and electronic records
* Skill in reviewing and comparing information from multiple documents to identify errors, inconsistencies, and discrepancies.
* Ability to inspect vacant land and properties, identify and document property conditions, and determine maintenance and remediation needs within established procedures.
* Ability to monitor and inspect contractor work to determine and document progress and conformity with applicable contractual requirements.
* Ability to read and interpret contracts, work orders, scopes of work, invoices, property records, and other documents.
* Ability to review invoices and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness, appropriate cost allocation, and consistency with authorized and completed work.
* Ability to accurately allocate project expenses and employee time among appropriate projects, work orders, and departmental cost centers.
* Ability to coordinate property maintenance and remediation activities with contractors, maintenance staff, departmental representatives, governmental agencies, and other stakeholders.
* Skill in using computers, spreadsheets, databases, mobile devices, and other technology used in property management, financial recordkeeping, and field inspection activities.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple assignments and follow matters through completion.
* Ability to identify discrepancies, resolve routine problems, and exercise sound judgment in determining when matters require escalation.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with PHDC staff, contractors, governmental agencies, and members of the public.

  

This is an administrative and field property management position responsible for coordinating the maintenance of vacant land and properties owned, managed, or administered by the Philadelphia Redevelopment Authority (PRA), Philadelphia Land Bank (PLB), and Philadelphia Housing Development Corporation (PHDC). The Property Management Coordinator administers related contracts and work orders; coordinates vendors, staff, and government agencies; conducts field inspections; maintains property and project records; estimates necessary repairs and replacements; allocates project and payroll costs; reviews invoices; responds to unauthorized occupants and other property-related issues; and works with members of the public, governmental agencies, contractors, and other stakeholders to resolve property management matters. Assignments involve the application of established procedures and practices to routine and moderately complex property management matters. Work is performed under general supervision, with unusual or complex matters being referred to superiors as appropriate.

  

**MINIMUM ACCEPTABLE TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE**

* Graduation from high school or possession of a GED or equivalent, and three (3) years of experience in property management, real estate, facilities or property operations, construction or project administration, contract or work order administration, or a related field.
* An associate's degree or higher in business administration, accounting, real estate, construction management, facilities management, public administration, or a related field may substitute for up to one (1) year of the required experience.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential functions of the position may be considered.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Work requires the ability to travel to and conduct inspections of vacant land, properties, and work sites throughout Philadelphia. Duties may require standing and walking; walking over uneven, unpaved, or potentially unstable surfaces; climbing stairs; bending, stooping, and reaching; and safely navigating vacant lots, vacant properties, and active or recently completed work sites.

**LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS AND/OR CERTIFICATES**

* Possession of a valid driver's license at the time of appointment and throughout employment in the position.

**Job Description:**

Join Baker Tilly, where exceptional people thrive as a Temporary Recruiting Coordinator! In this role, you will work closely with members of Baker Tilly’s People Solutions leadership and operations teams.

**Responsibilities:**

**Qualifications:**

* One (1)+ year of administrative or executive support experience, including managing calendars and experience within a talent acquisition function highly desired
* One (1)+ year experience with an ATS (applicant tracking system), preferably Workday (other example: Taleo, Icim’s, etc)

* Demonstrated level of technical proficiency with Microsoft Office Outlook and Excel at the Intermediate or Advanced levels required

f01d1fa23364d73cebc7.title: Commercial Portfolio Coordinator
f01d1fa23364d73cebc7.description:
**Job Description**

At WSFS Bank, we empower our Associates to grow their careers, guide our Clients to secure their financial futures, and actively support our Communities so they can fully thrive. Careers with WSFS Bank offer an inclusive and supportive culture, competitive salaries, advancement opportunities, and more. We are the region's locally headquartered bank and wealth management company. We are honored to consistently be named a Top Workplace by our Associates, who make a difference every day for the people, businesses, and Communities we serve. We Stand For Service® is more than part of our name, it’s our mission and our purpose.

The Commercial Banking Portfolio Coordinator will support assigned Portfolio Managers (PMs) and Relationship Managers (RMs) with certain loan activities related to the processing and closing of commercial loans. This role is responsible for an assigned pipeline of all commercial loan types related to the line of business supported and will act as the Pre-Closing Liaison to an assigned team within the Commercial Division, acting in tandem with the Loan Operations team. The Portfolio Coordinator will ensure all due diligence requirements are satisfied, compliance with WSFS policies, procedures, government regulations, and loan data is accurately reflected in required company operating systems as outlined in final credit approval.

Job Responsibilities:

* Determine due diligence required for each deal. Communicate requirements to relationship team, client, and attorney (as applicable) and plan accordingly to meet scheduled closing date. Act as an escalation point for involved parties to resolve issues and provide training around loan documentation and due diligence.
* Based on preliminary review of loan documents, identify needed modifications to the loan documents or the approval.
* Work with Loan Operations Closers and Flood Specialist to perform validation and confirm due diligence requirements for specific Borrower structures. Validate the KYC status of the customer along based on entity documents to ensure customers are in good standing/registered properly.
* Lend support to the RM in engaging approved external legal counsel and coordinating the closing date, ensuring that date is indicated (and modified when appropriate) on closing calendar, and complete preliminary review of loan documents.
* For all assigned loan closings, work with Portfolio Administrators to ensure that all associated loan fees are reflected accurately. Fees must be processed/collected prescribed timeframes by the PAs, with follow-up performed when needed.
* Communicate and partner effectively with other departments in the Bank and work as a team player to establish exemplary partnerships with all co-workers to create a positive team environment. Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively with third party vendors, customers, RMs, and other internal partners to address discrepancies/issues found during due diligence/loan closing/ongoing review process.
* Possess the ability to meet deadlines by working with multiple RMs on concurrent loan requests, including making ‘last minute’ modifications.
* Support the closing process by confirming loan closing package is ready for funding, ensuring that the package complies with the associated credit approval.
* Assist the RM with the clearance of delinquent documents and other exceptions with appropriate areas post-closing.
* Actively participate in departmental projects and committees as needed.
* Maintain WSFS internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
* Deliver high-quality service, while ensuring accuracy and timeliness of delivery.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Must have a Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or business-related field; or commensurate experience in the commercial banking lending field.
* Minimum of 2 years in Commercial Loan Operations or Commercial Banking loan support is required.
* Must possess knowledge of legal documentation and loan structure. Paralegal experience is a plus.
* Knowledge of banking products and services is required.
* Prior experience with Commercial nCino platform is preferred.
* Proficiency with personal computers as well as pertinent software packages.
* Must possess a strong attention to detail, with the ability to thoroughly interpret financial data and use sound business judgement.
* Must have excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as excellent listening ability and presentation skills.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision, as well as collaborating apart of a team.
* Ability to work under time constraints and handle multiple tasks in support of various assignments.
* Must have the ability to interact and establish good rapport with both internal and external customers.

WSFS Bank will only consider candidates who are presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and who will not require work visa sponsorship from WSFS Bank now or in the future in order to retain their authorization to work in the United States.

**Salary Range:**

$53,744.00 - $88,290.50

Individual base pay may vary on additional factors such as the candidate’s experience, job-related skills, relevant education, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

In addition to base salary, WSFS Financial Corporation (WSFS) and its subsidiaries may offer eligible Associates discretionary and formula-based incentive and retention awards. WSFS provides a competitive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; life, accident, and disability insurance; flexible spending accounts (FSAs) and health savings accounts (HSAs); and wellness programs. Additional benefits may include paid parental leave, military leave, vacation and other paid time off, sick leave in accordance with applicable state laws, and paid holidays. Benefit offerings are subject to eligibility requirements, legal limitations, and may vary based on an Associate’s location and employment status. For more information about Associate benefits, please visit https://www.wsfsbank.com/about/careers/

WSFS Bank is inclusive and supportive of individual needs. If you have a physical or other impairment that might require an accommodation, including technical assistance with the WSFS Bank Careers website or submission process, please contact us via email at careers@wsfsbank.com.

WSFS is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We are proud to offer a market-leading range of premium products across categories, styles and price points, remaining committed to beautiful design and, above all, a world-class customer experience.

The Data Entry & Payroll Specialist is responsible for entering, reviewing, and maintaining customer orders within the Company's ERP systems with a high degree of accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail. This role supports the customer experience and sales process by managing order entry, verifying order information, maintaining data integrity, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring orders are processed in accordance with company standards and procedures.

**Visual Comfort Offers:**

* Work-Life Balance: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm with occasional overtime and/or weekend work anticipated.
* Training & Development: A comprehensive and structured training program, complemented by ongoing education and opportunities for career advancement.
* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation accrual and paid time off policies.

* Compensation: Competitive compensation plan
* Health Benefits: Visual Comfort covers the majority of employee medical premiums, and offers competitive vision and dental coverage available starting the first of the month following your start date.

**How success is defined:**

* Enter customer purchase orders, RFQs, and related order information into the Company's ERP system, JDE.
* Review orders for completeness and accuracy, including pricing, quantities, product codes, specifications, shipping instructions, and payment terms.

* Communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders via phone, email, and other communication channels.

* Adhere to company policies regarding confidentiality, compliance, recordkeeping, and data management.

**What you will bring:**

* Minimum of 3-5 years of order entry, data entry, customer service, sales support, or related administrative experience.
* ERP system experience required; JD Edwards (JDE), or similar platforms strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Strong data entry skills with a demonstrated ability to maintain speed and accuracy.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to quality.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, manage changing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Experience in manufacturing, hospitality, design, wholesale/distribution, or related industries, and familiarity with logistics processes, is preferred.

Pay: $24.00 - $27.00 per hour

e2eac955747329d7eca2.title: Account Sales Representative
e2eac955747329d7eca2.description:
**Territory:** This territory covers Western Louisiana, including Lafayette, Lake Charles, and surrounding areas west of the Mississippi River.

We are currently looking for an **Account Sales Representative (ASR)** to join our Women's Health sales team!

The **ASR** is responsible for service and sales support activities to assist in driving market adoption and business growth. Core responsibilities include supporting the Clinical Field Specialists (CFS) increase revenue and drive market development through direct sales to individual MFMs and OB/GYNs. Support efforts include cultivating and maintaining key relationships, and creating and supporting a strategic business plan to grow revenue quickly. Support efforts will focus on currently marketed products and new product launches.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support CFS with a focus on closing business
* Work with assigned CFS to maintain & support existing customers
* Assess the needs of medical professionals and staff members with a focus on customer support, coordination of logistics, and problem-solving
* Promote quality client/patient relations and create a supportive climate by serving as a role model for other employees
* Respect and maintain the confidentiality of laboratory and financial information
* Practice and adhere to all company policies and regulations
* Follow Compliance procedures and participates in Compliance training
* Perform miscellaneous duties with completion in a designated time frame
* Communicate with Natera staff and its customer to ensure quality
* Maintain and support a service oriented relationship with customers
* Utilize personal and professional skills to promote excellent customer service

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 2 years of sales experience
* Background in medical or biological sciences preferred

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Proven track record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals
* Award winning sales professional due to individual achievements
* Exceptionally bright, flexible, self-motivated, and results oriented with strong interpersonal and analytical skills
* Ability to think strategically as well as execute tactically
* Must act with a sense of urgency
* Have a strong desire to work in a startup environment and must work independently with an internal drive to be successful
* Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal) with demonstrated ability to effectively present to both internal and external customers
* Effective time management skills required with a demonstrated ability to assess and prioritize
* Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; Gmail; Sales Force.com

The total **On Target Earnings (OTE)** offers a competitive base salary and uncapped quarterly commissions. In addition we also offer a car allowance, and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

1da24642317ef65f4b52.title: Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist - Atlanta, GA
1da24642317ef65f4b52.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 23 Oct 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.  

Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.

This role supports the Atlanta territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.

To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Provide** technical support for CRM devices and therapies by performing system checks/interrogations, supporting implants, troubleshooting issues, and applying knowledge gained through comprehensive CRM field training.

* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.

* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.

* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.

* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.

* **Maintain** technical expertise by staying current on new CRM products, therapies, solutions, and patient management offerings to effectively support customers and clinical outcomes.

* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time

* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.

* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

* **Performs** other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years **OR** Associate’s Degree PLUS a minimum 4 years **OR** Bachelor’s Degree PLUS a minimum 2 years of work experience in healthcare, field sales, or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science or computing

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in nursing, life sciences, or biomedical engineering

* 2+ years in Cath lab, EP Lab, hospital/clinic with cardiology knowledge

* Thorough working knowledge of medical terminology and the medical device industry

* Expertise with Microsoft tools & other applications (i.e., SalesForce.com)

* Ability to meet vendor credentialing requirements

Ability to coordinate/participate in numerous tasks/projects in a fast-paced environment in an organized manner while meeting deadlines  



For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .
‌

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$72000 - $90000
‌  
The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and specific locations in California. The offered rate complies with federal and local regulations and may vary based on factors such as experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others).
  
In addition to Base Salary, this position is eligible for a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), which provides the opportunity to earn significant incentive compensation for achieving or exceeding your goals.

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to those regular employees who work 20+ hours per week: Health, Dental and vision insurance , Health Savings Account , Healthcare Flexible Spending Account , Life insurance, Long-term disability leave , Dependent daycare spending account , Tuition assistance/reimbursement , and Simple Steps (global well-being program).

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to all regular employees: Incentive plans, 401(k) plan plus employer contribution and match , Short-term disability , Paid time off , Paid holidays , Employee Stock Purchase Plan , Employee Assistance Program , Non-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement (subject to IRS earning minimums) , and Capital Accumulation Plan (available to Vice Presidents and above, or subject to IRS earning minimums).

Regular employees are those who are not temporary, such as interns. Temporary employees are eligible for paid sick time, as required under applicable state law, and the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Please note some of the above benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

Further details are available at the link below:

Medtronic benefits and compensation plans

It is the policy of Medtronic to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Description:

**Aria Care Partners** is the national leader in providing onsite dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care to over 3500 long-term care and skilled nursing facilities across 25 states. Aria Care Partners believes that our clinicians should be able to focus on providing the best, most comprehensive care for their patients. Our clinicians visit different skilled nursing communities daily, bringing life-affirming care to an underserved population. Our business model, innovation, customer support and teamwork deliver an unparalleled customer experience, resulting in a customer satisfaction rating of over 98%. Executing this strategic philosophy resulted in rapid company growth with revenue increases of 25%-30% annually over the last 4 years, nearly doubling the size of the company. Company values include caring fully for our customers and fellow employees, striving for excellence and continuous improvement, and excelling through the power of teamwork and collaboration. At Aria Care Partners, our mission is to enrich the quality of life for every resident with passion and compassion.

**Working at Aria Matters!**

**THE POSITION**

Aria Care’s innovative collaboration with Medicaid and self-pay approaches can be a tremendous benefit to policy holders. It is the cornerstone of our passionate drive to provide essential healthcare services to an important contingent of our senior population.

Ideal candidates have a health insurance license to sell policies in one or more states, with good communication skills and the ability to sell themselves. Full equipment is provided, and we are offering a competitive base salary plus unlimited commissions with training taking around seven weeks to complete before building up commissions.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Educate prospects on the innovative ways to capture additional insurance coverages for dental, eye care, and auditory that may be little or no cost to the subscriber.
* Create a regular cadence of calls to connect and keep in contact with prospects and others influencing their healthcare decisions.
* Utilize best practices in sales and education guidelines to help maximize the conversion of prospects to the appropriate policies.
* Collaborate with Partners and Clinical Coordinators to address service issues from calls/customers to ensure the quality levels are maintained.
* Updates current database as needed to ensure resident and facility account information is up to date.
* Maintains and enhances product and technical knowledge in the industry.
* Sell Medicare supplemental policies such as Vision, Dental, Audiology and Podiatry.
* Meet or exceed monthly sales targets.
* Performs other job-related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:

**Education & Experience**

* Must possess a state-issued Health insurance license.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience in selling supplemental policies is preferred i.e. Vision, Dental, Audiology, Podiatry.
* Experience in the healthcare industry with supplemental insurance policies is preferred.
* Experience making outbound calls successfully engaging with prospects.
* Languages:
* Verbal and written fluency in English is required.
* Fluency in secondary languages such as Spanish or Mandarin is a plus.

**Other Qualifications**

* Planning/organizing — Prioritize and plan work activities to use time efficiently.
* Quality control/Attention to detail — Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness; monitor own work to ensure quality and apply feedback to improve performance.
* Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel – Able to use basic functionality in Excel, Word, Outlook and other company-based technology platforms.
* Adaptability — Adapt to changes in the work environment, manage competing demands and deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.
* Dependability — Consistently at work and on time, follow instructions, respond to management direction and solicit feedback to improve performance.
* Problem solving — A passionate pursuit of identifying prospect or client concerns and seeking resolution.
* Customer service — Quickly manage and diffuse difficult client/customer situations, respond promptly to customer needs, solicit customer feedback to improve service, respond to requests for service and assistance and meet commitments.
* Able to work in a team environment.

**Physical Effort & Working Conditions**

Work is performed remotely (home office) or in a normal office setting in our Overland Park, KS headquarters with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards. Substantial time is spent working on a computer.

**Benefits**

* A competitive salary complemented by uncapped commission, offering boundless earning potential!
* Target compensation $80,000-$100,000+
* Comprehensive paid training to kickstart your success.
* Activity based onboarding bonuses for new hires!
* Clear pathways for career advancement, allowing you to shape your professional future.

**Position Summary**

The Internal Services Coordinator is a highly organized and detail-oriented individual contributor responsible for providing administrative, recruiting, training, compliance, and project support across the Internal Services Group. This position serves as a central resource supporting Human Resources, Transportation, Supply Chain, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Risk Management, and Executive Leadership.

  

The Internal Services Coordinator plays a key role in recruiting administration, learning and development program management, driver compliance reporting, organizational reporting, project coordination, and cross-functional administrative support. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, initiative, professionalism, the ability to manage competing priorities, and a commitment to confidentiality.

  

**Core Duties & Responsibilities**

**Recruiting Administration**

* Manage job postings across recruiting platforms including BambooHR, Indeed and other sourcing channels.
* Coordinate candidate communications, interview scheduling, and hiring manager follow up.
* Conduct applicant screening and initial qualification reviews.
* Maintain applicant tracking records and recruiting metrics.
* Support pre-employment activities including background checks, MVR reviews, and onboarding coordination.
* Oversee I-9 documentation, EEO reporting and metrix.
* Prepare recruitment reports and workforce planning updates.
* Assist with recruiting campaigns, hiring events, and talent pipeline initiatives.
* Manage new hire orientation scheduling and compliance.

**Learning & Development Administration**

* Manage the company's Learning & Development platform.
* Assign training programs and monitor completion status.
* Generate training compliance reports for leadership.
* Maintain employee learning records and certifications.
* Support development initiatives, leadership training programs, and company learning campaigns.
* Assist with administration of mandatory compliance training.

**Driver Qualification & Compliance Support**

* Coordinate and maintain Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring processes.
* Conduct biannual MVR reviews for applicable field personnel.
* Track license expirations and driving record requirements.
* Maintain driver qualification files and compliance documentation.
* Assist with DOT-related administrative tracking and reporting.
* Coordinate quarterly random D&A requirements.

**Internal Services Administrative Support**

Provide administrative support to:

* Transportation Supervisor
* Supply Chain Coordinator
* HSE Manager
* Director of Risk Management
* Chief Operating Officer

Responsibilities may include:

* Scheduling meetings and coordinating calendars.
* Preparing reports, presentations, and meeting materials.
* Maintaining records, logs, and departmental documentation.
* Assisting with vendor communications and data collection.
* Tracking departmental action items and project deliverables.
* Supporting audits, compliance reviews, and operational initiatives.

**Project Coordination**

* Assist in planning and coordinating special projects across the Internal Services Group.
* Maintain project trackers and status updates.
* Coordinate information gathering from multiple departments.
* Follow up on deadlines, deliverables, and action items.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and process documentation.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare recurring reports for HR, Safety, Transportation, and Executive Leadership.
* Compile workforce metrics, recruiting data, training compliance statistics, and operational reports.
* Maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, and tracking tools.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of organizational data.

**General Responsibilities**

* Work safely and follow all company policies and procedures.
* Champion EnerStar's Core Values.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding employee and company information.
* Build collaborative relationships across departments.
* Support organizational objectives and special assignments as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Position Requirements**

**Education**

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Project Management, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

**Experience**

* 2+ years of administrative, HR, recruiting, project coordination, or business support experience preferred.
* Experience supporting multiple departments or leaders is an asset.
* Experience with learning management systems or training platforms preferred.
* Experience with BambooHR, BizLibrary, DISA, Novara Flex / KPA preferred.

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to prepare reports and analyze data.
* Strong customer service mindset.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
